notes.title: The Roots of Pacha 1.3 Update is out!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=FrHLB9qGL5k;full][/previewyoutube]

We’ve come a long way since first releasing Roots of Pacha almost exactly two years ago. We are so grateful to have such a positive community that has supported us along the way, so thank you!

The 1.3 Update is filled with mid to late game content, so there is no need to start over, that is, unless you want to. 

So! What’s in the 1.3 update, you might ask? Spoilers beware! 

After you complete the last challenge in the Forest Caves, Inza and Zeda will invite you to their respective lands, kicking off access to the new content. Then, once you complete the main story, centered around the Jungle Pyramid, the new areas will open even more!

Mograni Mountains

After you finish the forest caves, Zeda will invite you to the Mograni Tunda once you complete her request. There, you will find three sub-regions, each a little different than the next. 

New Characters
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/09a99957bb559cbf8d35c02898b50ceb92b98230.gif
Within the Mograni lands, you get to see Zeda, Touk, and Vallah, whom you may have already met in the 1.0 release, but you will also get to befriend 10 new characters, including one romanceable, Azkel. 

New Clothing and Decorations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/fce8e9284bb78868d2017f776fa43bcd9f1aaf10.jpg
You may have already traded with Zeda, but now you can also trade with other Mograni for a new outfit and decorations. And as before, once you befriend characters, they will send you a gift, including new hats and decorations.

New Animals
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/bdce8234c16cb98f7b12fe49b67387146c17105e.gif
You can befriend sivetherium, a prehistoric animal related to giraffes. Like some other pets, you can turn them into their adult forms with a “baby shroom” and ride these animals once you gain enough friendship. Then, in the icy mountains, you can find a new farm animal: the mouflon, an ancestor of domestic sheep.

New Seeds & Gatherables
As you explore these new areas, you’ll find lentil and rye seeds as well as dill, chamomile, and something called “soap root,” which you’ll need for a new Idea: Soap making.

Ideas
Soapmaking
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/375d70e08fcab187b6a6c7c7a1f99f76f30f59d5.gif
Jiyla will have an Idea that you can help develop for a new way to make soap. After finishing this idea, you’ll gain a new processor: a soap maker! With this contraption, you’ll combine soapsuds (made from soaproot) and herbs to create soap!

Fishing Traps
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/87061d441e095cb0ce922f8ef57764aa72307a98.gif
After gaining “bug catching” (more on that later), another character, Todu, will have an idea for Fishing Traps, a new way to catch fish. You’ll place a bug into the trap and return the next day to find a fish!

Fun and Games
Dice
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/5619745a3bc534c8c855264e5ced3b3f24a3eb91.gif
In the Main camp of the Mograni, you’ll find a cave where Cohh hangs out playing “Dice.” You can play him at this dice-throwing mini-game inspired by “Shut the Box.” A game that dates back to at least the 12th century. 

Festival of Quro
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/95de960bb05d58a1879fa20dbc753d13b6c4ef49.jpg
Join the Mograni Festival of Quro on Spring 26 and get to know their culture a little better, and join them in a game of ball, one of their traditional games. Here you will play a simplified foosball against characters there. Then end the day with a traditional firewalk.

Yakuan Islands

Once you complete the caves, Inza will have a quest for you that will result in you being invited to the Turtle Islands and visiting their three subregions.

New Characters
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/e89dec58178189dd7fff21c54bc7f7ec891b7a3a.png
You may have already befriended Inza, Brub, and Krak from the Yakuans, but in the 1.3 update, you will get to see them in the Islands alongside 11 new characters you can befriend, with one you can romance, Sayra. Like in the Mograni lands, you’ll be able to trade for a new outfit and decorations. Plus, these new characters will also send you a smoke signal gift once you become friends with them.

New Animals
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/eb1127f89935c57097c5b043ce13706f33b8f108.gif
While exploring these lands, you’ll find a new farm animal, the dodo, which will drop feathers and eggs. And on another island, a possible pet panda who will call your hut home if invited.

New Seeds & Gatherables
You’ll find rice and grape seeds as well as calendula and sugarcane across these beachy lands.

Ideas
Jam Making
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/bcf446e5637035d114128a10f033026ebf926981.gif
When you discover sugarcane, Ash will have an idea for turning their “mashed fruit” into something that stays fresh longer. If you help her develop this Idea, you’ll gain a processor that will turn your fruits and “muscovado sugar” (made by grinding the sugarcane) into Jam!

Line Fishing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/a6e2e20e8e4bcb622ceeed9df4d828fa20c9e47f.gif
After you complete the main story and gain bug-catching (explained more later still). Tayta will have the Idea for fishing out on the lagoon there. Here you will play a tension-based mini-game to catch fish. 

Fun & Games
Music
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/3b16967f4ef37d4bfea93230fdbbd67132495722.gif
On the main island, you can meet Solo and perform on the stage the music mini-game that is also in the Fall Carnival. As you play, you will earn “notes” that you can spend on more songs to play and collect!

Festival of Lune
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/4f907ba7812758bd197a2ba7ceb2356d47f4fe0e.jpg
Join the Yakuans on Spring 8 for a festival celebrating Lune. Here you will chat with characters, learn about the Yakuans, and play their traditional game, ball. Then end the day by sending lanterns to your ancestors. 

Sun and Moon Caves
Bug catching
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/d7deb29e3657396c6b5de8059bef3ea3d34e8fa2.gif
After completing the main story that takes place in the jungle and the two new regions, you will get a cutscene that presents you with a goal and the new mechanic of bug catching. Here you will play notes on an ocarina to herd bugs into a single group to catch them.

Sigils and new Trees
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/f9c834e6bd0b6858c1bb3da2f18a6c9a24c10af0.png
To travel into the caves, you will need to heal sick trees by bringing them the bugs that they need. After they are healed, you can collect sigils that allow you to progress deeper into the new caves. And if you give them even more bugs, you will gain a sapling of that tree for a total of 6 new saplings.

Evolved Animals
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/cc6a35085b3cfa9809f5453bfc70e8adda3767b4.gif
As you explore the new caves, you’ll come across tokens allowing you to breed animals in a new way. Allowing you to breed cows, chickens, goats, sheep, llamas, and pigs.

Evolved Plants
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/90881a8cb5a5f407b54a9dbf17120459f7300855.png
Within the caves, you will be able to unlock a total of 14 long-lost seeds that allow you to plant crops like yellow carrots or curly kale. 

A story to complete
As you complete the caves, you will discover more about this prehistoric world and how things came to be. And in the process, learn 15 cool new recipes!

Change Log:
Features

 New region Tundra, where the Mograni clan live, with 3 subareas.
 New region Islands, where the Yakuan clan live, with 3 subareas.
 19 new befriendable NPCs.
 2 new romanceable NPCs, Sayra from the Yakuans and Azkel from the Mograni.
 2 new tameable pets: pandas and sivatheriums.
 4 new plants: rice, grapes, rye, and lentils.
 4 new gatherables: sugarcane, chamomile, calendula, dill, soaproot.
 2 new tameable farm animals: mouflons and dodos.
 2 Ideas for new processors: jam making and soap making.
 2 Ideas for new ways of fishing: line fishing and water traps, with 18 new fish.
 Iron working Idea and iron tools with greater power/range.
 A new tool for bug-catching with a minigame.
 30 bugs to catch.
 2 new festivals: Festival of Quro and Festival of Lune, with a new ball minigame.
 Mograni Dice minigame with skins and other rewards to be earned.
 Amphitheatre minigame where you can play and learn new songs.
 Sun and Moon caves: where the main story that finished in the pyramid continues.
 6 new fruit trees.
 14 new plant variants to discover inside the caves.
 6 new animals to breed by discovering their trait selections in the caves: cow, pig, chicken, goat, sheep, llama.
 8 final tasks for game completion, cutscene, and reward.
 Added Special Deals mechanic when bartering with other clans.
 38 new decorations.
 2 new clothing options.
 2 new footwear options.
 12 new hats.
 19 new dishes.
 NPC minimap list filtering options.
 Meet Beast in the Mograni camp if the Touk 4 flower cutscene has happened.
 9 new Steam achievements.

Changes

 Beekeeping idea now also accepts any item tagged as wildflower besides sunflower.
 Bronze pickaxe power increased.

Thank you for following us on this journey. If you haven’t already, please leave us a review on Steam, it helps please the spirits of the algorithm.

Until next time!

You Rock!
The Soda Den Team

notes.title: Roots of Pacha 1.3 Sun and Moon Update: A Wealth of New Content
notes.content:
CGM first covered Roots of Pacha for Nintendo Switch back in 2023. After setting my eyes on it for the first time at Summer Game Fest, and as a huge fan of Stardew Valley at the time, I couldn’t help but be obsessed with it.



After spending more than 90 hours on Roots of Pacha on Switch, I still don’t feel like I ever quite scratched the surface of the game—I realize how wild that sounds. For games that I would consider Stardew Valley-likes, that is pretty common, easily sinking hundreds of hours into them. With Coral Island, Roots of Pacha, Fields of Mistria and more all coming out in the last few years, sim lovers have been eating well. That being said, Roots of Pacha has by far been the most intricate and unique of all of them.






That brings us to the Roots of Pacha 1.3 “Sun and Moon” free content update, launching on PC, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch today, April 22. As a Switch player, the Sun and Moon update was only available to me... Read more

notes.title: Devlog 56: ⭐ 2 Devlogs Until the 1.3 Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/6f87f5426d4cd49901ff1d4fa87bef655acd5d0d.jpg
Hello, lovely Pachans!

Things seem to be speeding up around here. There are now only two more devlogs until the 1.3 update drops! For those just joining us, we’ve been counting down devlogs instead of days, as we’d like the press to cover us and help spread the word. So, we have to keep the update release date under wraps for a little while longer.

Now, on to today’s devlog! Be aware of spoilers for new end-game content and mini-games!

Dice
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/5619745a3bc534c8c855264e5ced3b3f24a3eb91.gif
To play dice, you’ll want to chat with Cohh in the Mograni lands. You may have met him at a festival already. Once you play and beat him, you’ll get to play other clan members as well, with a total of 5 people you can play against.

This game is based on “Shut the Box,” a game that dates back to at least the 12th century. In this game, you will roll dice and click the tiles that add up to the number you rolled. The goal is to get the highest score, which will earn you new dice skins. You can also earn new dice by befriending two Mograni.

Performing Music
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/3b16967f4ef37d4bfea93230fdbbd67132495722.gif
In the 1.3 update, you’ll be able to play the music mini-game from the Fall Carnival Festival in the Yakuan Islands.

You’ll start with a few songs you can play and earn “notes” to spend on new songs. Perform more to collect the majority of the songs, with two more you can earn by befriending two Yakuans.

Bug Catching
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/d7deb29e3657396c6b5de8059bef3ea3d34e8fa2.gif
Once you’re invited to the new lands and complete the main story, you’ll gain access to bug catching. In this mini-game, you’ll play notes to herd bugs together and try to catch the largest group you can.

You’ll be able to use this new resource in a number of ways, to heal sick trees, as bait for traps in the Mograni lands, or for line fishing in the Yakuan islands.

Fishing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/a6e2e20e8e4bcb622ceeed9df4d828fa20c9e47f.gif
Who doesn't love to go fishing? Once you develop the idea for line fishing, you’ll gain access to fishing by raft on the mangrove island. In this mini-game, you will try to “reel” in the fish by controlling the tension on the line. When it starts to turn red, that means it is too tight, and your line might snap.

Ball
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/6e8459a1f00fd163e2c9a71a5583eabb39e60291.gif
We mentioned this game in our last devlog, but it had to be included here as well! In this mini-game, you will play a simplified version of foosball against other characters at festivals!

We hope you’ll have fun with these mini-games when version 1.3 drops. We certainly had fun creating them.

As a reminder, we are hosting an AMA on our subreddit, r/RootsOfPacha, on April 25th at 10 AM PDT / 9 PM CEST! You’ll be able to start asking questions a few days in advance if you can’t participate when the AMA goes live. We hope you can make it!

Keep looking to the stars, and we’ll see you again soon in the next devlog!

You rock!
The Soda Den Team

notes.title: Devlog 55: ⭐ 3 Devlogs Until the 1.3 Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/a4e74e4e18851667ff380038417140edd9da8ce6.jpg
Only three more devlogs until the 1.3 Update goes live! 🎉 If you’ve been following along, you know that we need to keep the date a secret a little longer. So, we are counting down devlogs instead. 🥰

On another note. Next week, on April 25th, Roots of Pacha turns 2! It’s been quite a journey, and we’re so glad you could be there with us! The best part of making this game is reading supportive comments from players who are enjoying what we created. It is an honor to bring joy to so many people, especially when the world feels dark at times. Thank you for being a light in our days as well.

To celebrate Roots of Pacha turning 2, we’re doing an AMA over on Reddit next week, Friday, April 25th, at 10 AM PDT / 9 PM CEST! The AMA will be hosted on the r/rootsofpacha subreddit, and you can start asking us questions a few days in advance if you won’t be able to participate when the actual AMA goes live.

Now that we’re in the party mood, this devlog will be about the two new festivals! One Mograni and one Yakuan. Spoilers going forward for themes, dates, a couple of screenshots, and a mini-game. 

Now, on to the devlog!

Festival of Lune
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/4f907ba7812758bd197a2ba7ceb2356d47f4fe0e.jpg
This Yakuan festival celebrates the second Child of Pacha, Lune, the moon. It is during this festival we honor our ancestors and thank them for all they went through to ensure our existence.

Once you complete the caves and are invited to the Yakuan lands you will also be invited to this all-important festival on Spring 8. There you can chat with everyone and play a traditional game of “ball.”

Festival of Quro
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/95de960bb05d58a1879fa20dbc753d13b6c4ef49.jpg
This Mograni festival celebrates Pacha’s first child, Quro, the sun, and the “inner fire” he gifted to humanity. It is here that the leaders must prove their dedication to Quro and demonstrate their ability to lead through strength. 

Once you are invited to the Mograni lands, you will be invited to this festival on Spring 26. There, you will get to chat with everyone and play a game they call “ball.” 


Ball
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/6e8459a1f00fd163e2c9a71a5583eabb39e60291.gif
Ball is an ancient pastime similar to what future people might call foosball. This simplified version pits two players against each other in stiff competition. 

We can’t wait to celebrate the release of the update with you! Thanks for sticking with us!
Keep looking to the stars, and we’ll see you in the next devlog!


You rock!
The Soda Den Team

notes.title: Devlog 54: ⭐ 4 Devlogs Until the 1.3 Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/e094816f36ea7577166cac7a0c6c2981985d68da.jpg
Welcome back for another Pachan Prophecy! There are only four more devlogs until the 1.3 update releases! Today, we’ll focus on caves!

The Forest caves of Roots of Pacha that you may have already explored held many secrets. Today, we’ll share a bit about the new caves coming in the 1.3 update, where a few new secrets await. We will do our best to tell you about the caves in the upcoming 1.3 update without divulging too much about what you will find inside.

That said! Spoilers are ahead if you choose to dig deeper into the caves.

Sun and Moon Caves
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/83977247776eae1ac981dd6fc00d7037c7563196.gif
Once you complete the Forest caves, Inza and Zeda will invite you to the new regions we have mentioned before in Devlog 46. There, you will find a closed-off cave in each area. Once you complete the main story, those areas will open up, allowing you to venture into their depths.

Unlike the Forest Caves, breaking rocks won’t open doors, but you may find an interesting new material or two if you try. This time, opening doors will require a “key” in the form of sigils found in the new areas. If this sounds a bit cryptic, worry not; a mysterious visitor will tell you what you need to know when the time is right. (There. I’m glad I could clear that up 😉)

Iron
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/14d0385fbe7d237c86746007adab9dc97c1ded03.gif
With new materials come new tools! Chop trees in only two hits, or harvest plenty of fiber for your animals in the savanna. Then, take a moment to appreciate how far we have come from the early days of using our handaxe.

Animal Evolution
While exploring the Sun caves, you’ll come across some tokens that will allow you to breed new kinds of animals like goats, llamas, pigs, chickens, sheep, and cows. You can read more about the new animals in Devlog 47. 

Plant Evolution
While exploring the Moon caves, you’ll find 14 long-lost seeds that will allow you to plant evolved versions of plants, like an orange carrot or a yellow tomato. To read more about the new plants in the 1.3, check out Devlog 49.

Thanks for joining us on this journey. We hope you continue to gather around the fire as we tell our tales.

Thank you for your continued support!


You rock!
The Soda Den Team

notes.title: Devlog 53: ⭐ 5 Devlogs Until the 1.3 Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/e303b2e9c36ef971a95ed5c94a5c57e01da06164.jpg
There are only five more devlogs until the 1.3 update goes live! As we mentioned in our previous devlogs, we’ve been counting down devlogs as we wait for our big release date reveal.

Developing “Ideas” is one of the core aspects of Roots of Pacha. It’s through these ideas that we see life change. It's hard not to get inspired when looking back on how these now common things revolutionized the world at the time. In the game so far, these Ideas have helped us water crops and process food. In the 1.3 update, we’ll have five more Ideas for you to develop!

If you choose to keep reading, the following contains spoilers for these Ideas. So, if you want to find out on your own. Now is the time to stop reading. 

Now, on to the Devlog!

Soap
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/375d70e08fcab187b6a6c7c7a1f99f76f30f59d5.gif
After you open the Mograni Tundra, you’ll find soaproot, and soon after, an idea will spark to life in Jiyla’s mind that you can help her develop. After that, she gives you a soap maker processor and a blueprint so you can craft your own. You’ll combine herbs and “soapsuds” to make a nicely scented new good.

Jam
We know the game is sweet already, but we figured it would be fun to jam out with some jam. In the 1.3 update in the Yakuan Islands, you’ll find sugarcane that will cause an Idea to bubble to the surface in Ash’s subconscious. After you help her develop that Idea, you’ll receive a jam maker and the blueprint to craft your own. Here, you will combine muscovado sugar (made from ground sugarcane) and fruit into longer-lasting jam.


Line Fishing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/3de5c6b7ed177c16a8c86ea5151da15bed3f70c6.jpg
In the Yakuan Islands, once you’ve completed the main story and have been introduced to bug catching, Tayta, one of the new characters, will have an Idea that will let you take a raft out onto the lagoon to fish. There, you will play a tension-based mini-game. To reel in the fish, you must keep the button pressed, but when the warning bar gets too high, you need to let go and release the tension before your line snaps.

Fishing Traps
Like with line fishing, after you’re introduced to bug catching, Todu in the Mogani Plains will have an idea to set traps on the lake there. With these traps, you’ll place a bug inside and wait until the next day to collect your catch.


Iron Working
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/38e5b363d0f7141fb6ad8ce997c47945a4af386e.gif
Our tools have come a long way since we first started the game with our handaxe. In the next update, you’ll discover new materials that will lead to iron tools. With this upgrade, you will be able to create tools to chop down trees with just two swings or clear 12 tiles of grass in the savanna.

Thanks for reading. Keep looking to the stars! And see you in the next devlog!

You rock!
The Soda Den Team

notes.title: Devlog 52: ⭐ 6 Devlogs Until the 1.3 Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/3152eb57eab0fa27080b4f92489dbfed3d36f2cf.jpg

We’re back with another Pachan Prophecy! We only have six more devlogs until the 1.3 release! As we mentioned in the previous devlog, we need to keep the release date a secret for a little longer, but we wanted to create a way to let you know that it IS getting closer.

Now, on to the devlog!

After tending the fields, it's nice to end your day in a cozy, decorated hut. And we absolutely love how creative people have gotten with the decorations so far! You all are amazing!

Once you complete the caves and open the new areas, in the 1.3 Update, there will be a number of new decorations for you to discover. Some you can trade for, while others the new characters will send them as gifts. In this devlog, we will highlight a few of the items you can trade for and who to visit to get them.

So, depending on what you consider a spoiler, as always, beware. 💖

Yakuan Decorations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/674e9b412216b75bb3a03e1d8ef5d2f9069b0c09.png
While visiting the Yakuans, you can trade with Ash for island-themed goods, like a seat carved to look like a turtle or a paddleboard to hang on your wall. She can usually be found on the Main Island, either listening to music or carving by the ocean.

You may also notice there is a new aspect that is added to trading where the Yakuan and Mograni clans will value certain items over others from time to time, so if you happen to have what they want, you can more easily get a “great deal.”

Mograni Decorations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/9c798e18226a800ab75704db9adf4cdcb4e08dcc.png
Or you can visit the Mograni and meet Nann, who lives near Mogra’s Fire, a fire that is believed to have been burning since the Mograni were first formed. There, she makes different decorations like a paintable pot shaped like a bear or a chair made of tusks.

Gift Decorations
Once you befriend the characters, they like to show their appreciation for you with a gift. The new characters will continue that tradition. Some gift decorations, while others gift recipes or new hats. For example, if you befriend Koli, she gifts you a sabertooth skull you can mount on your wall.

Thanks for following us on our journey toward the 1.3 update! We would love to hear what your favorite things to decorate with are! And are there any decorations you’d like to see in the game?

Keep your eyes on the stars for future devlogs!

Thank you for your support!

You rock!
-The Soda Den Team

notes.title: Devlog 51: ⭐ 7 Devlogs Until the 1.3 Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/bff1eb5186e75ede0c9391c0c9b0fc487f6c1c66.png

Hello again! We’re back with another Pachan prophecy about the 1.3 update! We noticed some comments about waiting to start the game or looking forward to starting over. So we wanted to clear something up. All the new content is mid-game or end-game. It becomes available only after you finish the [spoiler]caves[/spoiler], with even more unlocking after you finish the main story (aka the [spoiler]pyramid[/spoiler]). So you won’t be missing anything. Even if you’ve finished both of those, it will still make sense. 💖

As you can imagine, this update is a big deal for us, and we would very much like the press to cover us. Which means we need to keep the release date secret for a little longer. SO! We came up with a solution. A devlog countdown (see the title of this devlog). It’s not days, but it’s something we can share with you. (Just don’t tell anyone we told you 😉)

Now on to the devlog itself! Once again, spoilers ahead, so beware! We think there’s plenty more to discover about these characters, but we want to give a fair warning to those who want to go in fresh.

In our last devlog, we talked about two Yakugan characters, Akhi and Ugvin. In this devlog, we’ll focus on two new Mograni characters.

If you’ve played the game so far, you’ve likely met Zeda, the Mograni leader, and her younger siblings, Touk and Vallah. You may have also met Cohh, Havri, and Anda, the Mograni Keeper, at festivals. We also introduced Azkel in a previous devlog, the new Mograni romanceable character.

In this devlog, we will talk about two new Mograni Characters. Koli, Azkel’s daughter, and their neighbor Jiyla, the tailor for the clan.

Koli
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/9c4872dd636c8a756980568d4f0de47928db9ca6.gif
Koli may be fiery, but like her father, her heart is in the right place. She loves to explore and collect interesting things like skulls of strange, long-gone animals. She’s proud of her father and his past but wishes he would settle down now that he’s a bit older.

Koli can usually be found in the Mograni Plains or hanging out with her childhood friends Anda or Vallah when it rains. She loves caves and is especially happy when you gift her gems.

Jiyla
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/f9ae2d2839d4b72c21271b0a1c4817b2de3a125a.gif
Jiyla also lives on the plains near the lake, not far from Koli and her father. There, she and her partner, Todu, raise their young son Dag. Jiyla enjoys sitting by the fire sewing clothing. You can also trade with her for a new outfit!

Jiyla is as known for being quiet as she is for being an ultra competitor at dice and ball, two games the Mograni love to play. To really make this clothesmaker happy, gift her yarn.

We hope you enjoyed learning a bit about these characters that you’ll meet in the 1.3 update. When creating our new cast of characters, we first envisioned the culture they lived in as well as how they might see the world differently than Pachans. Their cultures are far more “independent” from the Pachans, even if they do get together from time to time. Pachans worry about their place in the clan, while the Yakuans and Mograni take pride in their independence, so they aren’t as concerned with their greater roles within their clans.

Keep your eyes on the stars for future Pachan prophecies!

You rock!
The Soda Den Team

notes.title: Devlog 50: 🏝️ Two New Characters
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/8b25382e9f0f41d6c4e99a213a11fcef3dead6af.png
Hello, lovely Pachans! 

We’re back with another Pachan prophecy about the upcoming 1.3 update.

This prophecy contains a handful of character spoilers. As always, you should stop reading here if you’d prefer to explore it on your own, but there’s still plenty more you can discover about these characters.

If you’ve played through spring, you’ve already met the leader of the Yakuans, Inza, her partner Brub, and their son Krak. During festivals, you may also have met Pellek, Kocha, Ash, and Javvi. And in an earlier devlog, we introduced Sayra, one of the new romanceable characters. In the 1.3 update, you will get to befriend all of those characters, as well as explore the islands where they live.

In this devlog, we will introduce you to two of the new characters: Ugvin, Sayra’s brother, and Akhi, Brub’s brother.

Akhi
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/c75fb34603fbdff5951a1c5dce3c35acb2f96ea6.png
Akhi is the clan’s chef and has absolutely zero tolerance for less-than-perfect food. Even though he’s known for being an opinionated force in the kitchen, he is as gentle as can be when teaching the children of the clan how to cook. 

He shares a tent with his beloved partner, Tayta, and their adorable daughter, Hunna. He’s a proud father, and it warms his heart to see his daughter’s best friend be the child of his best friend.

Ugvin
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/e89dec58178189dd7fff21c54bc7f7ec891b7a3a.png

Ugvin is the older of the two siblings and lost his partner shortly after they were blessed with Fayra. It was a tough journey being a single dad, but with the support of his sister and his best friend, he lives a happy life.

notes.title: Devlog 49: 🍒 New Fruit Trees & Plant Mutation
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/234e155f8f34ff223244c4870a81fd75e4d43e8e.png

Hey there, Pachan Farmers! It’s time for another chapter of the Pachan Prophecies. In today’s update, we’re unveiling more details about fruit trees and plant mutations. As always, this is the point where you can stop reading if you wish to explore the new additions on your own. 😄  

New Fruit Trees
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/f9c834e6bd0b6858c1bb3da2f18a6c9a24c10af0.png
Once you complete the main story, you will be given a new quest. During this process, you’ll get new plants, such as a cacao tree, a fig tree, and a vanilla orchid growing on its host tree, that you can bring back to your farm.

We really wanted to include the cacao tree in some way, since chocolate is a highly influential plant in our collective history. While it is easily found in our world now, its origins trace back to the cacao plant, believed to have originated in the northern parts of the Amazon rainforest. Its rich flavor and cultural significance spread across Central and South America before eventually reaching the global stage.

In Roots of Pacha, you will be able to use cacao beans to make hot cocoa, a recipe you’ll get by befriending a tea-loving Yakuan you may have already met in festivals.  

Plant Mutation
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/90881a8cb5a5f407b54a9dbf17120459f7300855.png
Similar to animal mutation tokens you’ll find in the new caves, you’ll discover seeds of this ancient knowledge that had been hidden away. A familiar yet new plant that you can choose to plant in its original or newer version. 

As with other seeds, once you discover this variety, you’ll be able to get more seeds from Igrork and plant whichever variation you prefer. Once you complete the new cave quest, you’ll also get recipes that use these new plants.

We look forward to seeing how you use these new plants on your farm! We absolutely love the hard work the artists put into their designs, and we think you will too.

Thank you for your continued support! ❤️

You rock!
The Soda Den Team

notes.title: Devlog 48: 💕 New Romanceables
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/1c6ff20a4493c925d4cadabff795cf8b225e4929.png
Hey there, lovely Pachans! 💕 It's time for a love-filled chapter of the Pachan Prophecies in honor of the day. In today’s update, we’re unveiling exciting new details about two new romantic characters, which also means some heartfelt new child dialogues—just in time for Valentine’s!

And remember, if you wish to learn about these characters on your own, now is the perfect time to stop reading 💕

Two Romanceable Characters
Sayra of the Yakuans

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/6b6ed0978d62248124ec2d76d889a2540a8ead43.png

After a heartbreaking change in her life, Sayra moved to the island to live near her brother Ugvin and his daughter Fayra. Overall, she keeps a cheery attitude, although she still carries a lingering hurt that still needs healing.

She loves being creative and helping with the two kids on the island, and she always gets excited when you give her popcorn. 


Azkel of the Mograni

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/09a99957bb559cbf8d35c02898b50ceb92b98230.gif

You will notice that many considered Azkel a hero, as he dedicated his life to disbanding raider clans.  But as time went on and one adult daughter later, he is starting to face the fact that life isn’t what it used to be – and maybe that's okay.

He can usually be found hunting, as it helps him clear his mind. But he's more than a little appreciative if you give him pierogies.

Many in the community mentioned wanting an older romanceable character, which would allow us to explore more about a character's past and their more established life before meeting the player. 

Azkel was inspired by the idea of a “silver fox” who became a rogue hero type, so having him become vulnerable with his feelings felt like a perfect match for character growth and romance. Although Sayra isn’t as old as Azkel, she has a past on her own, including a time when she was in love. 

Two sets of child dialogue
With two new characters players can form unions with, that means we now have new possible dialogues and hairstyles for children. 

We’re so glad players are enjoying this aspect of the game. We put a lot of love and dedication into it. We hope those who choose to romance Sayra or Azkel will enjoy meeting the children you’ll have together with them.


Happy Valentine’s Day! Wishing you a wonderful weekend!
The Soda Den Team

notes.title: Devlog 47: 🐄 New Animals & Animal Mutations
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/55eb8f00d555153fd51a9b45d9251fe511fadcfc.png
Hello Pachan friends, We’re back with another Pachan Prophecy! Today, we’ll share some details about the animals in the 1.3 update. As always, if you want to be surprised by the new animals you encounter, take this as your 'spoiler alert' warning from here on.

It’s easy to fall in love with the animals we encounter in the wild. Many of us have since befriended these lovely creatures, inviting them to live with us either as pets or on our farms. So, of course, the new regions needed to have some new animals. Who wouldn’t want a dodo as a pet? 😀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/eb1127f89935c57097c5b043ce13706f33b8f108.gif

New Animals
With this new update, we’re introducing four new animals to the game. Dodo, mouflon (ancient sheep), sivatherium (ancient giant giraffe), and panda. 

New Farm Animal
The mouflon can still be found in our world today, but its ancient history plays an important role. Considered one of the ancestors of modern-day sheep, it will join your farm once you befriend it. You’ll encounter this fine-footed friend in the mountainous region that the Mograni’s call home.

New Pets
The sivatherium was suggested by a Kickstarter backer who pledged at the animal tamer tier and chose it for its prehistoric awesomeness. You’ll be able to find this new animal in the lowlands of the Tundra. Though it may resemble a reindeer, this prehistoric pal is actually more closely related to a giraffe and okapi.

The fabulous, feathered friend, the dodo will live in our homes and become our pet. But don’t worry, your cave lions and wolves will treat them as friends, not food.

The panda was another fantastic suggestion by a Kickstarter animal tamer tier backer. As we explored its prehistoric origins, this animal became even more intriguing. Fossils of these bi-colored bears have been discovered in Asia and Eastern Europe. While their evolutionary roots remain a mystery, their undeniable cool factor is timeless.

Evolution through Domestication

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/6682a0e5804fe8116f5513318327b8f09d0bf2eb.gif

As you explore the new caves mentioned in a previous post, you’ll come across items allowing you to breed animals in a new way. For example, you’ll be able to breed goats from your forest ibex and sheep from the new mouflon, which you’ll encounter in the Tundra.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/605a4f1fb55a8e733fae0d86a3f92d0807f6e9b8.png

We hope you’ll enjoy meeting these cuties. We sure did enjoy making them!

Thank you for your continued support, and stay tuned for more prophecies. 

You Rock
The Soda Den Team

notes.title: Devlog 46: ❄️🌴New Regions
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/bd045581010349e83027c42d84d5e143e6e9adaf.png
Access the Tundra region and Turtle Islands where the Mograni and Yakuans live

Hi, lovely Pachans! We’re back for another Pachan Prophecy! We hope you had a wonderful holiday. We've rested and recharged, ready to continue work on the 1.3 update for you all 🙂

Today, we’ll explore the two new regions. We don’t think we are giving too much away here, but spoilers may be ahead depending on how “fresh” you want to go into the update.

We’ve already met some characters outside our clan, like Touk, Vallah, and Zeda from the Mograni, the people of the fire-loving northwest of The Land. As well as Krak, Brub, and Inza from the Yakuans, the people of the sea-loving south of The Land. But we’ve never seen where they actually live and come from - until now. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/e12861e8984bb7baa9c621cf39693722f3dfe987.gif
After completing the Forest Caves, Inza and Zeda will invite you to their camps, each asking for a small favor. So, just like other updates in the past, no “new” saves will need to be created to enjoy this content.

Explore the lands of the Mograni and Yakuans by traveling to their camps and visiting their sub-regions. You’ll discover new seeds, animals, their culture, and if you wish, play mini-games such as “Dice” in the Tundra or perform a song on the Turtle Islands. The Mograni and Yakuans have heard about what your clan has accomplished, and each has a new Idea they would like your help with. Then, as you complete more of the main story (if you haven’t already), an additional Idea will arise in each area.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/3a571948054cb323e2700f6a2413c15b6d1957d5.gif
When designing the regions, we wanted them to reflect their more spread-out nature and how that contrasts with the life the Pachans live. For example, the Mograni “follow power,” so their Leader, Zeda, and the clan’s spiritual advisor, Anda, sleep alone in a Cave on a hill. While most of the Mograni prefer to sleep “independently” in tents. 

As for the Yakuans, they follow “tradition” but are slightly more community-driven. They have something a little similar to the Pacha Hearth, where people gather. However, unlike the Pachans, they live spread out and rarely interact with one another.

Relatively little is known about our ancient history, which leaves a lot of room for imagination. When we take inspiration from the past for our new regions, we like to imagine what a collective history might look like and how it could be shaped by the cultures of the clans we’re creating.

We hope you’ll enjoy the new regions—we’re so excited to share them with you! In the next Pachan Prophecy, we’ll talk more in detail about the new animals we’re introducing.

Until then, take care, and thank you for being amazing!

You Rock
The Soda Den Team

notes.title: Devlog 45: 😶‍🌫️A mysterious visitor
notes.content:

Welcome to the Roots of Pacha 1.3 Prophecies Series!

The 1.3 update will introduce new features and content across all aspects of the game. Today we’d like to focus on a mysterious visitor who will play a role in helping you find all there is to discover in Roots of Pacha.

Once you complete the main story, you’ll encounter a mysterious figure who introduces you to a new mechanic, bug-catching. This will enable you to retrieve items that will allow you to venture into some new caves.

Until then, we wish you a happy holiday and a happy new year!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/b5bda0d2fe8c9fd9b5e2e9d629cab1f18be414ed.png

notes.title: 🔥 Roots of Pacha 1.2 update OUT NOW! 🔥
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Gi5VaBLplJw;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello Pachans! The 1.2 update and Xbox launch are finally here! Play cross platform with friends on Xbox, Switch, Playstation, And Steam! 🎉

In the 1.2 update you’ll be able to ride baby mammoths (and other pets), send your children to school, use an early watering system, and more! Read a detailed list about what’s all in the update in our Devlog 43 or peruse the change log at the bottom. 

The OST also had a massive update with 35 new songs added! Listen on Steam or YouTube. (Stay tuned for Spotify)

The Future

Our game may focus on the past, but it’s time to talk about the future! We have a massive update underway with two new regions, fishing in canoes/rafts, camping, ball sport, iron, volcano caves, and more! Even though we’ve made some awesome progress it’s still a little too early to share. We expect the update to come out next year and plan to share more about it later this year. 🥰

Thank you all for the support you’ve given us. We truly couldn’t have done this without you.

You rock!
- The Soda Den Team

Changelog 

Feats

 Intermediate saves: save and resume the game at any time by going to your bed and choosing “Save at current time.”
 Olla: an early watering Idea which holds 16 charges and waters the surrounding plants.
 School: a late game idea where the clan’s children will go learn with Daari.
 School learning station: after building the school you’ll get a learning station which can be placed in the fields affecting a 7x4 area. The children of the school will check it every morning to: clean affected sheds and talk to the animals living inside, water and harvest plants, refill ollas, pump irrigation pumps, harvest honey, and harvest trees. Up to 4 learning stations are available with higher prosperity.
 Children new stage: toddlers can be enrolled in school to make them grow up to school-age children. Your child will get one of 4 personalities and eventually choose from 8 professions, with unique dialogue and gifts for the different combinations.
 School-age children can wear hats, different clothes and you can also change their hair style and color.
 Newborn, toddlers, and school-age children attend festivals.
 Romanceables schedules adjustments to spend a bit more time in the house during the morning.
 Added more dialogue for romanceables.
 2 new Union locations: caves and beach, in addition to the existing Pacha Tree location.
 Kiss your partner in your Union reception.
 New dance music pools depending on who you dance with.
 Partners, nannies, and school-age children can now use the seats placed in your house.
 Added “Available to date” setting, which will prevent you from being asked to start dating in 6 flower cutscenes. The setting can be changed anytime in Settings->Gameplay and won’t affect your ability to use the context action “Start Dating.” 
 Added 5 new skin tones and 5 hair colors.
 Quick “Transfer all” and “Transfer matching” items in storage boxes and inventory. New Sorting methods added.
 Pets can be sent to fetch in different areas and bring back items from them.
 Cave lions and wolves can grow to be adult pets by giving them “Baby Shroom,” which is obtained in Glyptodon’s Tree shop.
 Some pets can be mounted: mammoths, spiders, adult cave lions, and adult wolves.
 Animals in the village will show an arrow when they’re in the tall grass area to make it easier to find them.
 Animals can be fed alfalfa.
 You can now put multiple items in processors (solar dryers, fermenters, etc.) by holding the main action button. It also works when picking up the produced items.
 Processors can now be removed while producing with a confirmation.
 New Village subcategory under Journal to show the prosperity objects and the players’ lifetime contribution.
 A button was added in Settings->Exit to take a screenshot without the UI.
 Trap locations now show on the map after interacting with them and show whether they have a trap and if it’s ready.
 Jag will now ask you if you want to go with him to the festivals that can be reached from the map: Competition Day, Clans Gathering, Cave Painting.
 Cave challenges can be exited to retry later. They can also be skipped and marked as completed, although no achievement will be given in this case.
 The unstuck button changes from a “Go back a few steps” to “Go back to checkpoint” when in the caves and now works when in owl/monkey mode.
 The dialogue before using the forest shortcut to the village is displayed only the first 3 times.
 Igrork’s nursery shows the current count of the selected seed in your seedbag.
 Mounts can be sent to their sheds/herds/home.
 Frer starts using the harpoon a few days after the idea is researched.
 Vallah, Touk, and Krak will always go to the New Year festival if they’re the partner of any player.
 New fishing mini-game UI
 Added Korean language.
 Added Traditional Chinese language.



Rebalance

 Lowered regeneration rate for field debris.
 Most meditation buffs will now last a full day.
 Stone fences need 3 stones instead of 4.
 Grob has some feathers and boar fur to exchange weekly.
 Fishing consumes a little bit more stamina.
 Animal sheds cost more at 750 contributions.



Fixes

 Active Idea smoke signals showing in “Past.”
 Riding points for players when racing.
 Water tool executing water animation when empty and not targeting anything.

notes.title: Devlog 43: 🎊 1.2 update is almost here!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=W7zAAvnLtCg;full][/previewyoutube]
The 1.2 update and Xbox release are coming July 31st! 

Check out the new trailer for some highlights, or continue reading for a more in-depth look at what's to come.

Wishlist Now on Xbox!

Animals
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/dd793b209eae77a4c3ec67dc7130e11aecbe2aa9.gif
Progressing friendship with your pets will give you a few more perks. You’ll be able to ask them to fetch in different areas (like the Forest or Beach) and depending on the pet, they’ll return with items like herbs or red meat.

Some pets could also turn into your trusty mount. With enough friendship, you’ll cruise across the lands on the back of a mammoth or giant cave spider. Once you complete the main story you can get a “Baby Shroom” from the Glyptodon’s Tree Shop and turn your cave lion or wolf cub into their ridable adult forms.

The tall grass in the fields could obscure animals, but in the update, a little white arrow will appear over them so you can more easily find them. 

Olla
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/e6a22d55ac4e1ce4050214a98b185a2642d503ad.gif
The olla is an early watering Idea that can quench the thirst of the surrounding 8 plants for 2 days (16 plots worth of water total). Every two days or so you’ll want to refill the underground pot so that the plots can be watered. Your upgraded watering tools will save you in filling time. Your starter watering skin will take 8 splashes to fill the olla, while the most upgraded bucket will only need one. This new watering system should free up more time and stamina for other things in the early and mid-game.

School 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/39a8474217952ce4df1c042891b810e7926ed7bb.gif
A late game Idea where the clan’s children go learn with Daari. This new building will lead to 
schedule changes, some automation on the farm with learning stations, and give your toddlers the ability to grow into children.


Learning station
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/256a373b31c6c423d57eb611ec3accf38a31123e.gif
After building the school, you’ll get a Learning Station that can be placed in the fields affecting a 7x4 area. After adding some contribution, the children will check it every morning to clean affected sheds and talk to the animals living inside, water and harvest plants, refill ollas, pump irrigation pumps, harvest honey, and harvest trees. Depending on your clan’s prosperity, you’ll get up to four Learning Stations.

New Stage for Children
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/2adafebd0d24df02d1ca9d9791bf9d6f67cba981.gif
Enrolling toddlers in school will cause them to grow into school-age children. These now active members of the clan can be found hanging out around the Village. Since we wanted your two children to not sound exactly the same, they will get dialogues based on one of 4 personalities, their parent at birth, their current parent, and whichever of the 8 professions you and your child choose. These combinations will help your children feel like more unique characters in the clan. You’ll get gifts from these characters based on the 32 different combinations of professions and personalities.

Dress your kiddos in hats and get new clothes for them from Jizu. Plus you’ll be able to change their hairstyle and color. Your children will also join you at festivals, including your newborn and toddlers.


Intermediate Saves
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/05c35ae1c1963e58245542c2e471204cf548c522.gif
We’re happy to say that this much-requested feature will soon be in the game. By interacting with your bed, you’ll be able to “save at current” time or go to sleep for the night as usual.

Deepening Relationships
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/da8b87cd60596b47e01fb63f5489f2150ce16e3c.gif

Form a Union with that special someone at one of the two new locations: the sandy Beach or the mysterious Caves. During the reception, you’ll now be able to kiss that special someone too. 

After your partner moves in, they will now get up with you so you can chat with them before heading out for your day. They will also have more dialogues before and after you form a union with them.

Your partner, school-age children, or toddler nannies can be found sitting on the furniture you place inside your home. To pick the best-looking direction, you can set the “preferred sit direction” to ensure no one finds the wall super fascinating. 😆

The clan has always been fine with you dating multiple people, but if you’d rather not have them express their feelings in their 6 flower cutscenes, you can now let everyone know if you are or are not available to date others in the clan.  The setting can be changed anytime in Settings->Gameplay and won’t affect your ability to use the context action “Start Dating.” 

More Representation
Korean and traditional Chinese languages are being added across platforms!

You can also choose from five new skin tones and five new hair colors to create your perfect Pachan.

Quality of Life
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/9623124aa50c4c1fb4f33ba1d5b8c1c96862c24f.gif
We’ve incorporated a bunch of your much-requested features into the upcoming update and believe it will help make the game an even better experience for many. Here’s just some of what is being added:


 A button to take a screenshot without the UI.
 Cave challenges can be exited to retry later. They can also be skipped and marked as completed, although no achievement will be given in this case.
 Trap locations are shown on the map after interacting with them and denote whether they have a trap set and if it’s caught something.
 Quick “Transfer all” and “Transfer matching” options in storage boxes and inventory. New Sorting methods as well.
 The unstuck button changed from a “Go back a few steps” to “Go back to checkpoint” when in the caves and now works when in owl/monkey mode.
 You can put multiple items in processors (solar dryers, fermenters, etc.) by holding the main action button. This also works when picking up the produced items.
 And more!!


Thank you all for your continued support! We can’t wait for you to get the update on July 31st! 🎉

The Soda Den Team

P.S. If you haven’t left a review already we would greatly appreciate it! It pleases the spirits of Steam.

notes.title: Devlog 42: What’s to come in the 1.2 and 1.3 update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/97c5882d21b1204d8f10b76b38d2b309ef1b6c5d.png

We’ve been hard at work developing the future content for Roots of Pacha and have devised a plan so that we can get you what was promised as soon as possible. Since all the content we want to add takes time to design, develop, and test, we’ve divided it into two juicy updates. The 1.2 update and the even bigger 1.3 update. With the 1.2 update arriving in early Q3 (in about 4 months).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/eb69e9a25891708b9a4ce30e1c0dbafeb9f66f42.gif

What the 1.2 update will include:

Xbox
This update will accompany the game’s release on Xbox. Xbox players will be able to enjoy the update and play in co-op with friends across platforms! 

Kids
Pachans love their children, and so do we. So we wanted to make sure having them felt like a meaningful addition to the experience. As before, you’ll be able to have two children, but once you build a school, you can send your toddler to school, and they’ll grow into a child. That child will have a set of dialogues and schedules to interact with you and the clan. With your gentle guidance, they’ll start to have their own interests in what they want to apprentice.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/165bf9ad9e2abc5da24c20b5dafe94c0b07d7de3.gif

Kids’ Learning Station
The clan’s kids have always helped their parents. But with the addition of school, kids learn about animals and agriculture by helping with an area of the farm. You’ll get help with the farm, and the kids get hands-on experience!

Union locations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/87d6f6ce199c92abd8563c3e547451fa9ff998c8.png
With so many beautiful places near the land, you’ll be able to select a location that perfectly fits you and your new partner. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/6f91b1efeae66594f80b0438fdc0712fdaf48c89.png

Fishing Game UI
In the update, each biome will have a unique look to its fishing mini-game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/3e920926c60d979b4d40f97e1366de106dcce6a1.gif

Pets
Animals have helped humanity throughout time, and soon, our pets will as well. You’ll be able to assign them to gather things for you. A cave lion might bring back meat, while a bunny might bring back produce.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/a442c850fabc8e059834a6b4cc0b72f2b79f0b3c.gif

Wolf pups and cave lion cubs have been warming themselves by our hearths for quite some time, and these two will grow into their adult versions if fed the right thing. Otherwise, these cute babies will stay as they are.

Early Watering system
Watering crops can be time-consuming, so the clan will have an idea for a more localized version of irrigation earlier in the game. This should help free up players to explore and do more in their Stone Age day.

More Dance Songs
You’ve already been able to dance with your Pachan friends, but with the update, you’ll hear a few different songs when you boogie with your buddies.

OST update
Roots of Pacha is filled with music, and soon, more of those songs will be added to the OST!
You can listen here to some samples

And more!
There’s more we are working on, including QoL updates like saving at any point. It’s a feature that’s been requested a number of times as a way to make the game even more accessible. 

What’s to come in the 1.3 update:

The team has been working on this update, and its large size is why we’ve decided to organize our work so that some of the remaining Kickstarter updates can be enjoyed sooner. Since these systems are all interconnected, they need to be developed in tandem and over a longer period of time. 

What’s to come:

 4 romanceable characters
 18 non-romanceable characters (you can spot two in the union scenes above)
 2 new biomes with 4 subregions each
 1 new cave system with iron and other materials
 Tent sleeping and unlockable homes in other regions
 2 new festivals with a ball sport mini-game
 4 new animals
 6 evolved animals
 New plant variations
 New line fishing mini-game
 An unlockable place to play music in the Islands
 An unlockable mini-game in the Tundra
 Hangout spots
 Many new cutscenes
 Quests


As you can see, we’re developing quite a bit, and this isn’t even everything! For example, we know we will be making more decorations and introducing the promised time traveler. It’s a lot, but we’re confident that at the rate we are developing, we’ll be able to add meaningful content to the game that will be worth the wait.

You rock!
The Soda Den Team

notes.content:

The first step of the Roadmap is already here. The Quality of Life update is now live! There is so much fun to discover, like:

Smilodon outfit. We love fashion and know this new outfit will make you smile.

New romanceable NPC. Enjoy more cozy moments with Jag in three new flower cutscenes and maybe even form a Union with him.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F37%2FJagRomanceable.png?alt=media

Pacha tree fruit. Once you complete the Pyramid, you'll be able to exchange for Pacha fruit that grants different boons to make your life easier.  Be sure to save a good amount of contributions. You'll need them.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F37%2FHomeDeco.png?alt=media

Moving buildings. Did you find a better spot for your home? Now you can relocate idea builds and your hut by talking to Croll.

Flower cutscene indicator. It can be easy to lose track of relationships when you're busy in the fields. A new cutscene indicator will help you know which villager is waiting to share a special moment.

Magic Hand Axe. Complete all the challenges in the caves to get this dream tool.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F37%2FMagicHandaxe.png?alt=media

Jukk, the stylist. For 500 contributions, you can ask Jukk to refresh your style.

Your house, your rules. If you pass out in your house, you will still wake up there.

You rock!
-The Soda Den Team

Full changelog

notes.title: Devlog 34: ⛺ It takes a village
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/5332c51615e798d88ade6ab86f90601b12c4cd48.png

Hello Pachans!

April 25th is around the corner, and we’re so excited for you to play the game! 

Before diving into the amazing journey it’s been developing the game, here are a few important things to note.

❗Beta and Backer Keys❗
As the release on April 25th is fast approaching, we’ve been working on the keys distribution website to ease the process of delivering them.

Now, you can manage your platforms at https://rootsofpacha.com/orders. You can switch platforms freely up until April 10th. On that day, the beta will end, we’ll invalidate all Steam beta keys and reissue Steam release keys. Any copies set to Steam will be locked for further changes. You’ll still be able to change copies from any console to Steam after April 10th, just keep in mind that if you do, you’ll be issued a Steam key and won’t be able to switch back to a console.

❗Release and Roadmap❗
On April 25th, Roots of Pacha 1.0 will be released on Steam for Windows & Mac!

In the following sections, we will dive into all the work we’ve done to have a 40+ hour game. We’ll also call out the places where we’ve laid down the groundwork for future updates. We are committed to adding all the Kickstarter stretch goals and features that expand on the 1.0 end-game. 

After the game releases, we’ll first focus on making sure the game is stable and a bug-free experience. Then, we’ll begin the process of porting and testing the game on consoles. As this happens, we will be able to share what our expected roadmap is for the remaining content.

Player Character Customization
We’ve added further customization options for your player character. You’ll be able to select one of 3 body types and pair it with one of 9 face options. 

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FCharacter-selection.gif?alt=media

You will also be able to choose from 15 skin tones, 34 hairstyles and 30 colors, 10 styles of facial hair, and outfits to fully express your stone-age self.

Flora of Pacha
There are more than 30 plants that grow natively in the regions of the world. Initially, you’ll need to discover where they grow and collect their seeds to plant them in your fields.

If you were a beta player, you’ll notice that wild plants will now only yield seeds. We made this change to better balance the game and make harvesting that much more rewarding.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FDiscoveries-seeds.png?alt=media

As you keep planting them, you’ll gain knowledge that’ll change how the plant looks, reveal its growth cycle, and increase the value of its yield. You’ll also be able to propagate seeds when you discover the “Idea” of a plant nursery.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FBees.gif?alt=media

You’ll also discover “Ideas” that will change how you farm: a composter to create different kinds of plant food and soil improvements, a beehive to promote their symbiotic relationship with plants, and eventually, an irrigation system.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FIrrigation.png?alt=media

We’ve updated the irrigation system to fit better with advanced tools that affect 3, 6, or 9 tiles at a time. Now, the middle tile in between two irrigation trenches will also be watered.

Fauna of Pacha
There are 7 tameable animals: Ibex, Ostrich, Wild Boar, Guanaco, Bison, Jungle Fowl, and Steppe Horse. Each with 10 variations to befriend and domesticate. On some days, you’ll find rare and even legendary variants hanging out with the herd.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FDiscoveries-animals.png?alt=media

Once you tame these animals, they are your responsibility to feed and care for as they may get upset tummies, coughs, or fleas, and you’ll need to give them some medicine. 

Once you discover the “Idea” of animal breeding, you’ll be able to raise their stats and get higher-quality produce from your well-cared-for friends.

After the 1.0 release, we will introduce animal evolution, where you’ll breed animals to get more modern-day equivalents.

The Caves
As you traverse the mysteries of the caves, you’ll gain new powers, discover new materials to craft with, develop new ideas, and evolve your tools.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FCaves.png?alt=media

The Lands & Neighboring Clans
You’ll be able to explore the land you settled, the nearby forest, the depths of the caves, the expansive savanna, and the calm waters of the beach. Along the way, you’ll meet a few characters from two neighboring clans, the Yakuans of Turtle Islands and the Mograni of the Tundra. 

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FCamp.png?alt=media

After the 1.0 release, players will be able to continue their stories and visit these areas. It’s also where we plan to introduce the Kickstarter stretch goals of camping, ball sport, the volcano cave, and fishing by boat.

Home Sweet Home
You’ll be able to personalize your home with over 200 types of furniture and decorations. After you complete the “Idea” of an art station, it will unlock the ability to “paint” your own canvases and pottery to get even more creative with your space.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FDeco.png?alt=media

Pets
In the 1.0 release, you’ll find 5 different pets and can invite up to 3 to live with you in a fully upgraded house. You’ll be able to pet them and have them follow you. 

After the release, we plan on adding more interactions with your pets.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2Fbunny-pet.png?alt=media

Friendship
Pachans love to dance, and with the right amount of friendship, they’ll dance with you too. It was important to us to create more ways to interact with the clan other than just gifting and talking. 

In the 1.0 release, there are a number of “world” cutscenes with non-romanceable characters that we felt helped tell the story of who the clan is. All players in co-op will experience these at the same time.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FAta-2F.png?alt=media

Romanceable characters also have 3 “personal” events (at 6, 8, and 10 flowers). Since we wanted you to experience all characters’ stories, the first 2 can be seen as either a hangout with a friend or as a date. 

In co-op, for the “personal” cutscenes, other players will go about their business as you’re whisked off to spend time with that character. Some of these events have different endings depending on what options you choose. 

After the 1.0 release, we’ll continue adding more cutscenes to help deepen the clan’s stories.

Romance
You’ll be able to date 11 characters after seeing their 6 flowers cutscene. You can choose to date or not, which will influence the way you experience the 8 flower cutscene. The 10-flower cutscene is exclusively a date.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FNpc-actions.png?alt=media

There is no penalty for dating all romanceable characters at the same time, although you can only form a Union with one. Actions, like kissing, will unlock if you date an NPC long enough.

In the 1.0 release, you will be able to form a Union with any of the romanceable characters by the Pacha Tree. In a future update, you’ll be able to choose your union location. And if desired, break your Union.

Children
Once you have a fully upgraded house and you’re in a Union, with either a character in the game or another player, you’ll be able to let Pacha know you’d like a child. With a little time, she will grant your wish, and a little one will appear. 

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FKid.png?alt=media

Cute as they are, infants are a lot of work and will need you to check in on them and take care of their needs throughout the day, or you’ll wake up tired from a poor night's sleep. The clan is there to help, but your child needs you too.

Once your little one is old enough, they’ll have their naming ceremony to become a toddler. As a toddler, you’ll experience new things, like teaching them to walk and start to talk.

After the 1.0 release, we plan to expand this and allow you to see your children grow into more life stages.

Pachan Festivals and Events
The clan loves to appreciate the world around them and celebrates in:

 Cave Painting - paint your history on the cave walls
 Clan Gathering - submit the secret judge’s favorite dish
 Fall Carnival - compete in a music festival
 New Year's Eve -  ring in the new year watching the northern nights and hearing a story
 Competition Day - compete in a variety of mini-games to win prizes
 Winter Festival - chat with the clan and have a grand snowball fight
 Racing Days - Once you discover racing, you’ll be able to race twice a season against other characters


https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FCompetition-day.png?alt=media

Hello Pachans! Another month of hard work has passed. We’ve continued to expand NPC animations, portraits, and their stories. Now, in this devlog, we will focus on a brand new festival and the expanded caves. 

Update on Release 
We have decided to move Roots of Pacha’s release to early 2023.  We have aimed to be as transparent as possible and need more time to deliver the experience we promised and the one we all dreamed of playing.

Game development is an iterative process with many interconnected systems that all need time and energy dedicated to them. The team is comprised of talented individuals who have both met and exceeded expectations regarding the alpha, beta, and demo. We are incredibly proud of these accomplishments so far.

With that said, even with a talented team and the “quick pace” we’re working at, we unfortunately lacked the experience to gauge how much time it would take to create the game we promised you all. To achieve the level of quality we want and that you all expect and deserve, we would rather take the necessary time to deliver. We’re confident it will be worth the wait. We may not have made our 2022 projection, but we aren’t far off either. We can see the finish line and need a little more time before we can give you an exact release date. We’re looking to announce a final release date in December.

We will continue to post devlogs to keep you updated on our progress as we take transparency very seriously. Our goal is to be as honest and forthcoming as we can with you. 

For our Kickstarter Backers, we are forever grateful that you chose to support the development of the game that allowed us to grow our team and make our collective dream a reality. So, as a token of our never-ending gratitude, we’d like to ease the wait a little by inviting you to join the Beta. notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/6e47ecbc122117e7b10c1a0fdd34f5a4a4f4adeb.jpg

We had a pretty amazing June! We started off with  Day of the Devs  and the associated Play Days event,  IGN Summer of Gaming , Steam Next Fest, and releasing a demo alongside it all. Seeing our work in the limelight has been an unbelievable experience, but nothing can top the amount of love we’ve received from people playing the demo.

With so many players, we’ve received helpful feedback that we’re incorporating into the game. Some examples include a way to return from the top of the Forest mountain without retracing your steps, increasing options in the character creator, and more!

One of the incredibly exciting parts has been seeing our community grow. We grew so much this month that all 5 fires were lit in the Discord mini-game! 

 Cutscenes 
We’ve been busy creating storylines, music, and animations to bring another layer of depth to the game. In this last month, we’ve given a little extra attention to Illoe and Garrek. 

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F25%2Filloe-Gif 2.gif?alt=media

 New Processors 
The clan has more Ideas in the works such as a pickler, vinegar maker, brewer, and cask. You’ll be able to process your crops into something that lasts a little longer and is more valuable to the clan when you contribute it. 

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F25%2FProcessors.gif?alt=media

 Map Redesigns 
We already had a beautiful waterfall in place, so it seemed like a fun idea to be able to go behind it. Now, players will be able to find their way back home by taking a shortcut to the bottom of the hill. So those late-night trips back from the caves should be a little less stressful.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F25%2FForestshortcut.png?alt=media

The landscape of the Savanna is also receiving a few changes to add more diversity and detail to the landscape.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F25%2FSavanna-03.png?alt=media

 The Future 
With the knowledge gained from our Beta and the demo shortly thereafter, we plan to go full “nose to the grindstone” (while of course maintaining a healthy life for the team) in these upcoming months and focus on what is essential to get us to a solid 1.0 release. Our future devlogs will likely be sparse compared to our usual updates or include [redacted]s so that we can avoid spoiling too much.

As always thank you for your support.

You rock!
-The Soda Den Team

notes.content:
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F24%2FDevlogBodyHeader.png?alt=media

We’re celebrating our upcoming demo Pachan style with a Festival! Besides the release of the demo, we have a few exciting events planned this month, including a segment in Day of The Devs (a part of the Summer Game Fest), streams, and more! Be sure to tune in at 11 am on June 9th for the kick-off of Summer Game Fest. We think you’ll like our segment. 

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F24%2FDayOfTheDevs.png?alt=media

The Demo
Most demos are around 30-60 mins long, but the Roots of Pacha demo will be eight in-game days or approximately two hours. We went into detail about what’s included in Devlog 23.

The community will have a chance to get two more days (about 30 minutes of playtime) by unlocking fires in the Demo Festival Challenge.

A Collective Experience
During the Kickstarter, we had a social media challenge where the community could achieve smaller stretch goals without backing the project. This support helped us reach a larger audience and was a way for anyone to contribute to the campaign without spending money.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F24%2FStatue.gif?alt=media

Besides earning more Beta raffles, the community can unlock items in the demo that aren’t “needed” but can change the experience. You’ll get things like a decorative statue, a bunny hat, two more in-game days, and a golden pomegranate that raises your friendship with animals.

By using the power of your social networks to spread the word of Pacha, the community will “earn fires” when a milestone is reached. Every 2 fires lit, a reward will be unlocked.

New Additions to the Demo

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F24%2FStatue.gif?alt=media

Character Customization
We’ve made significant strides in the character customizer, including more skin tones, hair colors, hairstyles, and another outfit.

You can now get hats from Jizu and equip them in the “you” menu tab.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F24%2FMinimap.png?alt=media

Mini-map Update
The more detailed mini-map will help you find your way. There are icons for the animals and plants you’ve found. The list of people also now gives you more info on each character, like their in world sprite, if they have an idea, and if you can exchange with them like Jizu, the clothing maker.

Game Intro

New People to Exchange With
You can now exchange with Grob for meat and other animal products. For now, it can be smoked and dried, but it will be a part of recipes you can cook. In the future, there will be vegetarian substitutes for the recipes that require meat.

notes.title: Devlog 23: 🚪Trials
notes.content:
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F23%2FDevlogBodyHeader2.png?alt=media

We want to thank all of those who were able to play and test the Beta. The warm reception the game has received is beyond our wildest dreams. Thank you for all your continued support. 

We can’t wait for you to see all that is being developed and planned for the game’s release. In the meantime, we are excited to have people try out a demo next month.

Demo
Along with developing the game, we’ve been working on a demo that’ll be in Steam Next Fest (June 13-20th). Most demos are 30 to 60 mins long, but with all the content we have, that wasn’t enough time to really get a feel for Roots of Pacha, so we are aiming to have a demo that’s about 2 hours long with some tailored features.

Exploration
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F23%2FDiscoverTomato.png?alt=media
Exploration is such a big part of the game, so you will be able to discover plants, befriend animals, adventure in the caves, and forage through the forest and the land surrounding the village. 

Ideas
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F23%2FIdea-Sundial2.png?alt=media
“Ideas” are a major mechanic for progression. In the demo, you’ll be able to discover the power of time through the sundial and develop the idea of animal taming. One change for the demo is that you’ll start with the Idea of “animal friendship” already developed, so you’ll be able to use the flute to befriend animals. After progressing your friendship with them, you’ll discover the Idea of animal taming and riding. To allow you to rapidly develop these ideas for the limited demo, you’ll start with some contribution as well.

Fishing
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F23%2FFishing.png?alt=media
Along with farming, you’ll be able to fish in the waters surrounding The Land Between Two Rivers. You’ll use your handaxe to track fish and strike when the time is right. We hope you enjoy our unique take on fishing.

Processors
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F23%2FSmoker.png?alt=media
There will be plenty of processors and the ideas that accompany them for the final game. For the demo, you’ll be able to complete a contribution quest with Tare to earn a smoker and a fishing quest with Frer to earn a dryer. Processing the fish you catch and some of the plants you find will yield better contributions.

Lore and the World
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F23%2FRiteOfPassage.png?alt=media
You’ll be introduced to Pacha’s world by befriending your fellow Pachans, watching a shortened intro cutscene, and experiencing your Rite of Passage Festival. The Rite of Passage is an important event in every Pachan’s life when their totem is revealed. At the festival, you’ll be able to earn a perk along with learning more about your world. 

The Caves
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F23%2Fowl.png?alt=media
Explore the depths of Pacha’s caves and overcome the challenges that await you.  

Saves
The demo is only a sample size of the game, but another big part of the game is “playing at your own pace.” To give people the opportunity to try different play styles we’ve decided to allow you to save, start multiple runs, and play in co-op. 

Beta Update

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F23%2FGameIntro.png?alt=media

We’re working on a Beta that includes improvements for multiplayer, more player customization, an intro to the game, updates to fishing, and improved character schedules.

All “Be-ta Shaman” Kickstarter backers and above should have received their keys. If you can’t find the email you can have the key resent by entering the email you backed the game with here: https://rootsofpacha.com/orders/ 

Pachan Festival
Pachans love a good party, and so do we. The Beta was a big milestone in development and the demo is another. To celebrate our very own “Rite of Passage,” we have some cool things planned for the community. So keep an eye out for next month’s devlog and our social media for the details. 


You rock!
-The Soda Den Team
