notes.title: Devlog 22: 🌄 Pacha calls
notes.content:
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FDevlogBodyHeader.png?alt=media


Hello Pachans!! This is a mammoth-and-a-half-sized 🐘 update for the game! We’ve added irrigation, expanded caves, romance and dating, a complete overhaul to the ui, new character portraits, and more! (more info on those in devlog #19, #20, #21). In this devlog, we cover a few new ideas, trading, animal updates like racing, and a whole lot more listed at the bottom of the devlog. 

We can’t wait for Be-ta Backers to play (and send their feedback too!). For those anxiously waiting the game, we’ll have a demo in June we hope you’ll enjoy. 🔥🔥🔥

There’s still a “road to be walked,” with lots of content to develop, but we’re more than happy with the state of the game right now. To celebrate, we’ll be doing a live stream with SharkyGames on Tuesday, April 12th at 10 am PDT on YouTube 🥳🥳 Hope to see you there!

The Ideas of Ideas

"Ideas" are one of the most important aspects of the game. We implemented and tested a few processors in the Alpha that are now "Ideas" in the Beta. For example, you'll help Tare develop a Press that helps the clan juice more things.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FTinWaterBucket.gif?alt=media

Once you explore deep into the caves, you'll find tin that will spark an "Idea" on how to work with this new material. From there, you'll be able to upgrade your sickle and make a tin bucket that holds more water.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FIrrigation.gif?alt=media


Make watering your crops even quicker by developing the Idea of irrigation with Garrek. After he sees you using your new tin watering can, he will have an idea he would like to discuss with you. 

Trading

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FZelkArrives.png?alt=media

Our Pachan friend, Zelk, returns to the clan along with his partner, Nari, and their daughter Era, who have never met the clan before. Through Zelk, we'll get the "Idea" to trade with others, giving us the ability to get resources that are harder to find.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FTrading.png?alt=media

Social

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FIbonChat.png?alt=media

We need each other to not only survive, but to thrive. In this update, we implemented more of the social side, which was many, many months in the making.

Dialogues

All characters now have a minimum of ten dialogues. The two romanceable characters in Beta Frer and Mana have over 50 and 40 dialogues, respectively. We feel this is a good "first coat of paint" on the social system and something we look forward to expanding upon for release. 

Gifts

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FGift.png?alt=media

All characters have a set of loved, liked, disliked, and hated gifts that will affect your friendship with them with unique dialogue associated. You can also get an extra boost to friendship if you give them a gift on their birthday, especially a loved gift.

A Few New Looks

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FNewReese.png?alt=media

While redesigning the portraits, we gave a few characters a fresh look in the world that better fit their personalities and added to our cast.

New Place To Get Things

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FReeseShop.png?alt=media

Decorate with things that Reese made. Visit her and find what items will help you turn your hut a home. 

She will also have some extra fabric that will allow you to expand your belt and carry more items as you travel the land.

Animals

Racing

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FRace.gif?alt=media

In the Alpha, we could only race with others in multiplayer. Now, you'll be able to race Mana and Jelrod every Saturday. It also will become part of clan culture and something near and dear to some of the characters. We look forward to telling you more about this as we expand this Idea.

Animal Updates

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FGuanacos.png?alt=media

We had a few animals with color variations in the game, but we thought it was time for guanacos and bison (who are now rideable) to get some new styles. You can also gather fur from boars by shearing them.

Improved Mini-Game

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FAnimalGame.gif?alt=media

Like fishing before it, we felt it was time to give this game a little more polish. To attune to an animal, you will play the game until you fill all the notes. It may take you one try or a few. Some animals will be harder to tame than others.


The Lore Expands

The story is something we don't want to spoil for those who wish to discover it for themselves, so we'll remain tight-lipped on many parts. So instead, we will tell you the question we hope to answer: what brought us to the Land Between Two Rivers?

Caves have been a spiritual place throughout human history and we aim to honor that legacy with a thoughtful experience and a dash of humor. We hope you'll enjoy the adventure.

Quality of Life

We now have full controller support! This not only offers us a better experience now, but it will help us when we develop for consoles later.

We now have an easier-to-navigate UI. This was a massive undertaking that took a lot of time and attention. You can read more about it in devlog 21.

We’ll have a Mac OS build in the near future. So our alpha and beta backers who prefer to play on mac should have access soon.

Mark Your Calendars!

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FStreaming.gif?alt=media

After a busy few months, we wanted to hang out with the community again, so we’ll start a new save and stream the game on Tuesday, April 12th at 10 am PDT on YouTube. Plus, we’ll be raffling a few Beta Keys! We hope to see you in chat!

We’ve mentioned it a few times in the Discord, but we are excited to announce we will have a demo on Steam in June. We can’t wait for people to play! Stay tuned for more info.

Added Features

 Revamped UI
 Full controller support
 New portraits
 New game intro and initial quests
 New introduction to the Yakuan and Mograni clans
 Tutorials
 New Rite of Passage, choose offering
 Mortar, press & fermenter ideas
 Hammering idea
 Tin tools
 Irrigation idea
 Cheesecloth idea
 New preserved items: dried fruit, fermented vegetables, butter, mayo, sour cream, cheese
 Trading idea
 Arrival of trader family
 Inventory expansion
 Frer & Mana are fully dateable
 Kiss mechanic
 Pacha Tree Union
 NPCs now have more dialogue and schedules
 NPCs gifts and birthday reactions
 Skip button in cutscenes
 Overhauled caves with lore and new challenges
 Guanaco & bison variants
 Bison are now rideable
 Wild boar produces fur
 Anima domestication thresholds
 Mana and Jelrod race with players
 New tattoos
 Item placement outside farming area
 Host won't get kicked if the internet is lost
 Time stops when in UI
 Stamina hit if you pass out
 Steam Cloud saves





You rock!
-The Soda Den Team

notes.title: Devlog 21: 🎨 You and I
notes.content:
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F21%2FDevlogBodyHeader.png?alt=media

Hello Pachans! With only one month left of development until the Beta milestone, lots has been done in Roots of Pacha and there’s still more to come. In this devlog, we’ll focus on two big changes: the intro to the game and the new UI.

New Beginnings

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F21%2FNewIntro.png?alt=media

With Beta backers gaining access to the game in a month, we thought now would be a great time to focus on and test out how players are introduced to the game. We wanted to create something that wasn’t overwhelming for new players yet not too intrusive for those familiar with the genre.

In the stone age, ideas were passed on through stories and art. On day one, Igrork will introduce you to the concept of farming and you’ll receive your first cave-art tutorial on how to farm. If you are familiar with the game or the genre, these “pop-ups” are easy to close and will be something that people can revisit later in a future update.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F21%2FYakuansVisit.png?alt=media

After this initial tutorial, other timed events will follow, like introducing other ideas, the opening of the caves, beach, and savanna. Spreading out these events allowed us to tie them more closely to the story of the world without intruding too much on how the player spends their time.

The game will also have its first “quests” introduced that will reward you once you complete them. 

The story of how you arrived to Pacha's lands will be further integrated into the early stages of the game, but the full story will be told at the game’s launch.


New UI

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F21%2FMenu.gif?alt=media

Great UI helps with accessibility and clarity, so this is something we’ve given a lot of attention to over the past few months with a complete overhaul. The new look and improved functionality will help us lay the groundwork for future integration with controllers and consoles later.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F21%2FIlloeChat.png?alt=media
 
This new style gave us a chance to spruce up the characters’ portraits. We loved the previous art, but this new look is far more expressive and a direction we’re excited to continue.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F21%2FFriendUi.gif?alt=media

With the new UI, you’ll be able to track your friendship status and what gifts they liked (or didn’t) and see when their birthdays are.


Thank you for your continued support. We’re just making a game about community and the importance of kindness, but we can’t help but hope life would imitate art a little more. Stay safe out there. If you can, we’d appreciate it if you did one extra kind act like buying coffee for the person behind you in line, donating to a worthy charity, or picking up litter. The little things add up. The world needs it right now. 🧡


You rock!
The Soda Den Team

notes.title: Devlog 20: 💖 A Deeper Meaning
notes.content:
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F20%2FDevlogBodyHeader.png?alt=media

Hello, Pachans! Love is in the air and the clan is feeling it too. In this devlog, we’ll focus on two aspects of the April 8th update: romance and caves.

Depths of the Heart

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F20%2FReception.gif?alt=media

Although Pachans don’t celebrate Valentine's Day, they’ve been in a romantic mood lately. In the next update, you’ll be able to date and form a union with Frer, Mana, and two other characters.

In an earlier update, Frer had 2 “world” cutscenes added to the game that told a little bit of his story. The upcoming build will have 3 additional “personal events.”

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F20%2FManaDate.png?alt=media

What’s the difference between “world” and “personal” events you say? Glad you asked! 
World events are triggered by going to a specific location between certain times and will include all players, if playing in multiplayer. These types of events often carry over into the dialogue and daily routines affecting the world as well. 

A “personal event” is player-initiated through dialogue and includes only that character and the person who initiated it. If playing in multiplayer, everyone else will go about their business as usual. These events are more like “dates” or hanging out with a friend, in some cases. 

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F20%2FKiss.gif?alt=media

Once you gain enough flowers with Mana, Frer, or one of the other dateable characters, you’ll be able to pursue a relationship with that special someone and give them a kiss for a small boost in your relationship.

Once you reach 10 flowers, you can form a union! A union consists of a short ceremony with a reception following right after.  At the reception, you’ll be able to walk around in your union attire and chat with guests before heading back to the village with your new partner in life.

This will continue to be expanded on beyond what will be in the next interaction of the build. We want your partner to be a meaningful part of your life and continue to have a life of their own as well.



Depths of the Soul

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F20%2FCaves_Surprised.gif?alt=media

You’ll cross into the edges of the spirit world in the forest cave. There, you’ll meet some totem guides that will help you through its mysterious depths. 

Throughout the cave you’ll find challenges to test your ability to observe the world around you. This iteration of the caves is just the beginning with more totems and puzzles planned for the future.


Depths of Gratitude

February 22nd is the one year mark from when we first launched the Kickstarter. It’s been beyond a dream come true. Because of all the backers and the support of the community as a whole, this game will be something even better than what we first imagined. 

Over the last month, there’s been a resurgence of attention for our little game thanks to one of our artists posting on Reddit and an article on PC Gamer. To all those who have been around since Kickstarter or before, we hope you join us in welcoming the new folks to our community. The fact that so many people are interested in a game centered around discovery and kindness is truly inspiring. 


You rock!
The Soda Den Team

notes.title: Devlog 19: 💧 Fresh Waters
notes.content:
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F19%2FDevlogBodyHeader.png?alt=media

Hello Pachans! 

We’d like to wish you all a Happy New Year! Let 2022 bring you plenty of warmth, bright moments, and happy memories. 2021 was an amazing year for us, full of surprises, events, and unwavering support from our community. To our Kickstarter supporters specifically, thank you for believing in us from the start, spreading the word, and giving us a chance to fulfill our dream. We quickly smashed the initial goal and ended up 1,115% funded! 

It was a wild ride, hitting stretch goal after stretch goal, with many happy tears shed. 

Following the Kickstarter, we were able to achieve another enormous milestone: a playable Alpha. Since then, we’ve released 6 major Alpha updates, each containing new game mechanics, overhauls, and polish. 

Your feedback has helped us improve Roots of Pacha and shape the game to become the best possible experience for players. As we continue to work on the game, please keep it up! We’re paying attention to everything you have to say. 

At the end of 2021, we spent time scheduling things for next year and evaluating the team’s progress. Here are our plans for 2022: 

Our next update will be Beta

Those who pledged at the Beta level will get access to the game on April 8, 2022! This will be a huge milestone for us and we can’t wait for more players to try out the early version of the game. This date gives us an extra month in our development cycle so that we can polish this juicy update.

New Ideas
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F19%2FIrrigation.gif?alt=media

As ideas shape our world, they continue to do so in Roots of Pacha. New Ideas like Hammering, Trading, and Irrigation will find their way into the Beta. 

Item Placement
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F19%2FPlacingItems.gif?alt=media

Make your decorative mark on the village and place items where you’d like. Players will no longer be limited to placing items in the fields.

Dating and Marriage
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F19%2FUnion.gif?alt=media

Eyeing that special someone? We will add 4 datable characters with which you can eventually form a union. Each character will have their own series of cutscenes, so you can get to know them a little better. Their dialogues will be expanded following the Beta, but we can't wait for you to learn more about our first 4 datables.

Polish
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F19%2FMinimap.gif?alt=media

Our mini-map reflects the village you create (including your crops), so it felt only natural to have it reflect the season as well. 

We’ve been working on adding a new layer of polish to the game with new UI and updated character portraits.

And More
We’ll expand on these and other updates in the future as we continue to do our monthly devlogs. So stay tuned for more. 🔥

If you still haven’t joined our Discord, be sure to do so. We have alpha/beta key giveaways, mini-games, and much more to discover! 

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2FDiscord.png?alt=media


Release
After taking a hard look at what we wanted in our 1.0 release, and considering the increased scope that came with Kickstarter, we realized we need more time than our initial projection of Q2 of 2022. Our current plan is to release in late 2022.

This was not a decision we made lightly, as we strived to find the right balance of getting the game into your hands as soon as possible and how much content can be made to create a complete experience. 

We take pride in our game, story, and community. Even if we too wished we could release sooner, we feel that given a little extra time, we can offer a more polished and meaningful experience - one that is worthy of you, who make this all possible.

We believe the future of this game is brighter than ever. The community centered around a game about kindness and cooperation has only grown. The team has only gotten stronger, and the dream of two brothers has become so much more.

You Rock.

-The Soda Den Team

notes.title: Devlog 18: ❄ Crossings
notes.content:
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F18%2FSteamDevlogHeader.png?alt=media


Happy Holidays Pachans! We couldn’t think of a better way to wrap up the year than with a New Years Festival and live stream. We hope you were able to join us, but if you couldn’t, here’s a link if you’d like to check it out. Otherwise, we hope you enjoy the summary below. 

[previewyoutube=IxphJ6uTikU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


Thanks for being such an awesome and supportive community. We look forward to seeing what 2022 brings!


New Years Festival

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F18%2FFestivalStory.gif?alt=media

Join the clan for a New Year’s festival at the mountain summit. You’ll chat with the characters to hear many of their wishes for the upcoming year, listen to a story about how the northern lights came to be, and watch the lights in action.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F18%2FLights.gif?alt=media

The Great Connector

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F18%2FCrossBridgeImage.png?alt=media

Vuak has a vision that there’s something you need to see on the other side of the river. You’ll have to gather supplies from far outside the land, but once you do, you’ll be rewarded with the start of a grand challenge that will continue at release.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F18%2FMeetOwl.gif?alt=media

Player House Upgrades

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F18%2FPlayerHouseUpgrade.gif?alt=media

You’ll be working hard and might want a little extra room to stretch your legs (or invite that special someone to come live with you). Once you get enough materials and contribution points you’ll be able to upgrade your house and your kitchen as well! Having an upgraded kitchen (and the utensils that are being developed to go along with it) will expand the possibilities of the dishes you can make.


Everyday Life

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F18%2Fwoodchop.gif?alt=media

We continuously add layers of detail as we develop the “big” things in the game. As you explore the world, you’ll find the characters going about their business, which mostly includes helping the clan like Jag is. He looks after the village by making sure there’s always a fire ready to warm your hands or cook with.

As you venture around the world and experience the different seasons, you’ll hear music and ambient sounds that shape the world. We hope you enjoy all the hard work and love that has gone into creating this experience. 

We’ve also put another coat of paint on the characters’ likes and dislikes. This will continue to evolve as we add more things to the game, but each character now has a neutral, dislike, like, hate, and love response for gifts and a couple of items for each.

The interior of characters’ homes are also being designed to reflect their unique personalities and roles in the clan. Tetih is the oldest member of the clan who enjoys the “finer” things in stone age life, like decorative rugs and a big cozy bed.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F18%2FTetihChat.gif?alt=media

Building for the Future

It’s exciting to be working on aspects of the game that don’t fit nicely into one “sprint” or “devlog cycle.” These are the parts of the game that will weave the world into something greater than the sum of its parts.

Love is an important part of the human experience and our history. It’s important to us that it’s meaningful in Roots of Pacha. So we’ve been working hard to create a story for each character you can date and the system surrounding how you go about seeing that special someone.

We’re also working on stories and cutscenes with other people in the clan as well as the deeper meaning of what Pacha has in store for us. A lot of this work won’t be reflected in the alpha as it’s still being developed.


Until Next Time 💖

Thanks for taking the time to read what we’ve been up to. We hope you and yours have a happy and safe holiday. You rock!

-The Soda Den Team

notes.title: Devlog 17: ⭐ Reach For The Stars
notes.content:
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F17%2FDevlogBodyHeader.png?alt=media
Hello Pachans! We’re back with another mid-sprint devlog! We say it every time, but we continue to make huge strides in the Roots of Pacha world. Progress has been made with character activities and their homes, the main story, a winter festival, and so much more! We hope you enjoy reading about what we’ve been up to.

Character Homes & Activities
The clan was getting cold from the last wintery update, so they wanted to get cozy inside. This sprint we’re working on updated interiors for some of the NPCs. Each home in the clan will reflect its unique inhabitants. Can you guess who calls this house home?

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F17%2FHouse_Interior.png?alt=media

The clan has many chores they need to do throughout the day. You’ll find various characters going about their business with their new animations.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F17%2FIgrork-Sweeping.gif?alt=media

A Greater Calling
After completing a quest that takes you to the Jungle, you will find a mysterious pyramid topped with four totems. Through this structure, you will progress through the larger story by completing different “quests” and learn why you were destined to live in the Land Between Two Rivers. 

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F17%2FJungle-Pyramid-WIP.gif?alt=media

If you’ve seen our Kickstarter trailer, you know it ended with a pyramid. This pyramid will be added to the game, although in a different form. We loved the original style of the pyramid, but when we started to work with it in the game, its style felt out of place in the more organic world of Pacha. So we reworked it to fit within the world and the story we’re telling.

A New Year

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F17%2FWinter festival.png?alt=media

The end of winter signals the coming of new life. You will join the clan as they say goodbye to the chill of winter and welcome spring. You will travel to the top of the snow-covered mountain where you will make “wishes” for the coming year, tell stories, and watch the lights of Quro dance in the sky. 

House Upgrades
You’ve been working hard gathering and planting, so we felt it was time that you’re able to upgrade your home. Expanding your house will allow you to form a union with your special someone and have them move in. Then eventually have children join your hearth.

Those who love cooking will be able to expand their repertoire of dishes with new appliances and utensils that are unlocked at each stage. Then you’ll be able to make your friends the meals they love.

Love & Marriage
We started adding cutscenes last alpha update, and work has continued on how you can woo that eligible single who catches your eye. We want to make sure that your union feels meaningful to both you and the character.

Switch Progress & Unity 2021
Like Pachans preparing for winter, we know how important it is to prepare for the long term. Lots of progress has been made with optimizations, the save system, joystick support, and cross-platform play with Switch. We also upgraded the project to Unity 2021 early, which has allowed us to take advantage of some of the new features as we optimize and keep our “tech debt” low.

Epic
We’re excited to say that Roots of Pacha will be available on the Epic store as well as Steam when we release next year. We’re excited that even more people will be able to play our game. 

Thanks for sticking with us through this journey. Your excitement and continued support mean the world to us. If you haven’t already, we hope you join the community in Discord.

Leave a comment with whose house you think is included in this devlog and why. 💖

notes.title: Devlog #16: 🐟 Knifetooth
notes.content:
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F16%2FDevlogBodyHeader.png?alt=media
Hello, clan! We’ve just completed another development cycle and big strides have been made in the Pachan culture and the world as a whole. We have a full four seasons, an updated fishing mini-game, a new idea, two new other clans, and big changes in how the characters interact with you and the world.

Winter
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F16%2FWinter.gif?alt=media
It’s time to gather around the fire as snowflakes are falling in the Land Between Two Rivers. You will now be able to experience winter and cycle through an entire year! Each season will continue to be improved, but we’re excited to have reached this milestone!

A few new chill-resistant plants, gatherables, fish, and seasonal music can be found while exploring the land.

Social
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F16%2FGins.gif?alt=media
We’ve started to give the social aspect of Roots of Pacha a lot more development focus. We added summer and raining schedules, dialogues, and animations to breathe a little more life into the characters' daily routines. 

On rainy and snowy days the clan will hunker down inside, but their activities won't stop. You’ll be able to see Pachans hanging out at the Pacha Hearth or at each other's homes. In this development cycle, we added Gin and Tare’s home interior and made it accessible within the alpha. Their home has a little extra grandeur to it from their status within the clan, but they’re still welcoming to their fellow Pachans.

Friendship
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F16%2FDance.gif?alt=media

Like other farming sims, you’ll be able to talk with and give gifts to NPCs to improve friendship, but true to the culture of the world, dance will also help you connect with characters. But a character won’t want to dance with you right away so you will need to raise your friendship to a point where they’re happy to bust a move with you. You’ll be able to check your friendship status (represented by flowers) in the Journal and see who you’ve given gifts, danced with, and spoken to.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F16%2FFriendUi.gif?alt=media

Once you gain enough friendship you will be able to see world-changing events for some characters. We feel it's important that your actions, including your friendships, change the lives of the characters around you. They may start going outside the Land or spending time with other characters. 

We have many cutscenes in the works but we started with Frer’s first two. Alpha players will be able to see them at two and four flowers. Since we’re developing for single and multiplayer, these two cutscenes can be experienced by all players at the same time. After these two cutscenes are experienced, Frer’s schedule will change slightly to reflect his character development. We’re excited to expand on this direction in storytelling.

We gave a few characters a makeover. After our Gamescom Festival, we wanted to give Ibon and Jelrod a look that better reflected the divas that they are.

To create the living breathing world we have a lot more cutscenes, schedules, dialogue, animations, and characters to add. But we’re pretty happy with the strides we’ve made these past two months.

Roaming Clans
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F16%2FMograni.png?alt=media
We’ve started working on two other roaming clans, the Mograni and the Yakuans. These groups seem to be the opposite in almost every way. One lives in the cold North while the other makes the Turtle Islands home. No one remembers what started this feud but the clans have little to no kind words to spare for each other. Thankfully for them, Pacha gave our clan a sign to settle between them. Could this be a part of a larger plan?

Three characters from each clan have been added to the alpha with a few dialogues each.  It’s been exciting to see the early stages of this story take shape and we’re looking forward to expanding on it.

Fishing
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F16%2FFishing.gif?alt=media
Like Pachans we strive to better our ideas and our fishing mini-game is one of them. After getting player feedback and testing it ourselves we felt it needed an update. We decided to change the way the hover works and more clearly indicate where you needed to keep your cursor within. From there, an indicator will fill up to 4 bars when it's time to strike. We also changed how the fish became aware of you. Once they see you you have a short time to move the cursor away and wait for them to go back to not noticing you before resuming your progress in catching the fish.

A New Idea
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F16%2FYakuans.png?alt=media
Although Pachans are innately inventive, they’re not the only ones with Ideas. Yakuans and Mogranis have their own way of doing things and have been mastering their surroundings for years. Once they trust you enough, they’ll share their way of living with you and maybe you’ll even invent something together.

Discord bot
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F16%2FDiscord.png?alt=media
Starting in October, instead of having alpha raffles based on the top players of our Discord minigame, everyone will be able to earn “tickets” 🎟️ based on their own achievements. 

The clan works together to unlock “fires” that will translate into the number of alpha raffles we do at the end of the month. We start with 2 fires (raffles) and each additional one is unlocked based on everyone’s total contribution. 

If you haven’t already, join us now for a chance to win, and hangout with the awesome community. You don’t want to miss the new #🎈-wholesome-memes channel! 💖😂🦆

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2FDiscord.png?alt=media

What’s next
We’ll work to expand on the social aspect like dating and marriage, add new ideas like irrigation, and continue to weave the threads that tie the world together.

notes.title: Devlog 15.2: 🍂 Fall in love with music

Pets

Beach

Ideas

What’s next


We’re going to focus on winter and deepening the story of the Pachans and the surrounding Clans.


Join us in discord to get the news first on what’s to come!

notes.title: Devlog #14: The power of rocks! ⛏
notes.content:
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F14%2FDevlogBodyHeader.png?alt=media

Hello Clan! Summer brought many new plants to our Clan, and our old tools could barely keep up. Acre, Igrork, and Ata have a few Ideas on how to improve things.

Plant Knowledge
It all starts with a seed, a tiny powerhouse that provides for the clan. There are no stores, and traders are too infrequent to get these all-important parts of farming life. 

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F14%2FWildAndDomesticatedCropped.png?alt=media

When you return from the wilderness with a seed, it will first grow as it did in its wild form. As you tend to the plant, the Clan will gain “Knowledge” about its needs. This will change how the plant looks, and it will start bearing a domesticated version of the original wild yield. 

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F14%2FTomato.png?alt=media

The more we sow and harvest a plant, the more Knowledge we’ll accumulate. Once a plant is domesticated, its yield quality will improve as it’s tended. This quality will affect contribution, refill rates of stamina, and even how much a Clan member will like that item.

Plant Nursery
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F14%2FNursery_Sketch_Black.gif?alt=media

It has always been our adoptive grandad’s dream to tend to plants and, although he is too old now to till the soil, he wants to help. Once you reach a specific Knowledge of plants, he’ll come up with the idea to create a “Plant Nursery.” There, Igrork can help by tending to the plants and providing a new source to get seeds rather than out in the wild.

Tools
The hands of our Clan have accomplished a lot, but it was their innovation of tools that allowed them to do more.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F14%2FObsidian_Sketch_Black.gif?alt=media

After you find obsidian for the first time, Acre will have the Idea to build a workstation that will allow her to work with these new-found materials. With the necessary resources, you will be able to improve your tools from flint to obsidian, tin, copper, and even to materials that require smelting.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F14%2FHoe.png?alt=media

Ata, the ambitious kid with a Hammer as a sidekick, will have the idea to start smelting metal. With her and her parents' help (she’s little after all), the Workstation will be improved to accommodate her wild idea to make metal stronger by mixing it.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F14%2FSickleHarvest.gif?alt=media
These upgrades will allow you to accomplish more with less effort. 

Bot
Cooperation is important to us, that’s why it plays such a pivotal role in Roots of Pacha. Our intention with the Discord bot is to have something fun that reflects that and brings everyone in the server together.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2FDiscord.png?alt=media

Starting July, instead of giving the alpha keys to the top 2 contributors, we’ll raffle 2 keys within the Top 15 contributors. But that’s not all, we’re also bringing back the community goals to increase the number of alpha keys raffled. Depending on how much contribution we all make as a Clan, we’ll raffle up to 5 alpha keys per month, the first 3 among the Top 15 and the last 2 among the Top 50.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F14%2FFourFires.png?alt=media
A 3rd alpha raffle has already been unlocked !! 🔥🔥🔥

We just started working on updates to the bot. We’ll begin with mini-quests for the whole Clan, which will unlock new plants, a hummus item to save for whenever you’re hungry and need more stamina, random campfires for you to rest at, increased max stamina for a limited time, and new emojis for the server.

Coming up
Some other things that are in the works for the next update:

A New Season
The leaves are changing, and the air is getting crisper. Fall brings with it lots of exciting visual changes as well as a toe-tapping festival for all to enjoy. 

The Beach
Fall is coming to the Land Between Two Rivers, but it’s still warm by the beach. We’ll be able to explore the area and find new plants and fish.

The next month’s edition will be a stream showing off this mammoth-sized alpha update. Stay tuned! You rock!

notes.title: Devlog #12: A new season begins ☀
notes.content:
Hi Clan! It’s devlog time, and we’re starting to feel the summer vibes. 🌴 Here’s what we’ve been up to 🔥.

Surveys and rewards
All surveys have been sent to backers, and we’re at over 90% completion. If you still haven’t gotten the invite to PledgeBox or have any questions about your survey, please email us at support@rootsofpacha.com or message @creb or @berkza on Discord. 

We’re organizing the production and distribution of physical and digital rewards. They’ll be sent in batches closer to release, and we’ll update their status in the devlogs.

New team members
We also wanted to tell you that we’ve got two new animals joining our development team! Squid will be helping us on the coding side and Kangaroo with the scriptwriting. 

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F12%2Fzoo.png?alt=media

Alpha
On April 8th, the alpha went out to Al-fire backers and above, and we’re very happy with their comments so far. Thank you so much for the feedback, bug reports, and streams. 🥰 We’ve categorized and prioritized all of it to fit it in our development cycle.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F12%2Fstreams.gif?alt=media

The pre-order store is now closed, but we’ll continue to give alpha keys to the winners of our Discord community minigame. Some members of the community are also doing their own giveaways with extra keys they’ve purchased.

The timeline
In our previous devlog, we mentioned we would split the remaining work to match the dates of the alpha updates. 

Every month, we’ll share the status of our general project overview, as well as what we plan for the upcoming alpha update.

Our current broad strategy is to include a new season and region in each alpha iteration until we complete the in-game year and the whole map. At that point, the game will have a complete cycle, and the alpha will no longer “end” at a specific in-game date. Along with it, we’ll work on features and mechanics, new content, fix bugs, and make quality of life improvements. 

The next alpha iteration
Kickstarter orders took a while to process, but we believe we’re still on track to deliver the next iteration in early June. This is a preview of what we’re working on:

Summer
Days are getting longer in real life (in the northern hemisphere at least), so it was fitting that we worked on the next season of the game. This will allow alpha players to kick back and relax in the summer heat with new plants, animals, dialogues, and even a new event!

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F12%2Fsummer.png?alt=media

Seasons affect almost everything in the game. For summer, we’re adjusting some systems and developing new ones. The good news is that all efforts made for this new season will make fall and winter easier to implement.

Savanna
The other main feature we’re working on adding is the savanna which lies northwest of The Land Between Two Rivers. It’s a place of tall grasses, canyons, and shallow waters.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F12%2Fsavanna.gif?alt=media

This geography is very special to the Clan. A long time ago, in a place similar to this, they learned to stand upright to walk on their two feet, and overlook the tall grass.

New Fauna & Flora
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F12%2Fgualknaco.gif?alt=media
To accompany both the new season and the map expansion, we’re improving and adding new animations for some animals.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F12%2Fmilk.gif?alt=media
In the current alpha, the only animal that produced something was the female ostrich (guess what she drops... that’s right, an ostrich egg!). Now, you’ll obtain something from each of the current tameable animals. For some, you’ll need a new tool like a milk container to milk your ibexes.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F12%2Ftrees-2-rows.png?alt=media
We’ve redone the trees to match the style of the other assets better. We aimed for a more natural look. We’re also working on new plants that will spawn in the summer, like tall grasses and bushes.

New Event: Rites of passage 🌱
The Clan celebrates rites when there’s an important event in the life of one of its members. One of those events is the passage to adulthood. 

Soon after the Clan settles in their promised land, the shaman decides it’s time for a “Rite of Passage.” And this one is very special, as it’s your time to make an offering and take the oath of caring for your Clan.

What would you offer your Clan, and how would you like to help?

Next devlog, we’ll show you the progress made on these features, along with other things planned for the next alpha update:

🍅 Split items in the inventory
🦙 Multiple animal sheds
🐮 Name animals 
🧀 Some new processors and items
🎶 Music for each area in spring and summer 
💬 More character dialogues 


Thank you for reading! If you’ve got any questions or just want to be part of a great community, we invite you to join our Discord!

notes.content:
The Festival is over. Time for the after-party! 💃🕺
Hello Clan!! We had such a blast at the Festival of Kickstarter. Thank you all for having fun with us, and for all your support and love. 💙

Pre-order store

The Pachan Cooking Contest
Food, so much food 🤤🤤🤤. Our stomachs have been growling nonstop for the past month. Thanks to everyone who participated!

Raffle Winners
🥁🥁🥁 Congratulations to @askjdniasucialsd, @batonga, @rollingstampede! You’re the 3 winners of the raffle and will be getting access to the alpha 🔥!

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F11%2FRaffleWinners.png?alt=media&token=e18804fd-b6a1-40cc-a491-d0ca49745e39

Main Prize Winners
We’ll be choosing the 2 main prize winners in the next few days. You’ve made this really hard for us, your creativity, descriptions, and yumminess were exceptional!

What we’ve been up to 
While planning and running the Kickstarter campaign, we continued to build on the game even after letting streamers play.

During this past month we’ve added:
Style & new decorations
We added tall grasses that spawn in batches, 3 flooring types (dirt, wood, stone), worked on item alignment, and updated plant shadings. This is how the game looks now:

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F11%2FStyle.png?alt=media&token=fc09ef1f-5e7a-44fe-a4bc-29f29225eb9c

Food
We’ve added the initial cooking mechanics with a few recipes you can make and their animations!

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F11%2FCooking.gif?alt=media&token=cc79bd34-6018-4682-931b-69c72312896d

To expand on the importance of food preservation, we’ve added fish drying and fermenting to the existing processors.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F11%2FDryingFish.png?alt=media&token=d2444034-f6c0-443b-9808-267dbada5c32

Multi contribution & Storage
A much-requested feature by the content creators who played the pre-alpha, and something that was on our backlog, was the ability to contribute multiple items at once. You can now open a contribution menu to easily contribute after a good day of foraging and harvesting. You can even recover what’s been contributed for the day if you accidentally dropped it in.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F11%2FContributions.gif?alt=media&token=356afcbe-7682-4b31-a88c-e4a775f36352

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F11%2FStorage.gif?alt=media&token=8a3a7aa6-14af-45e8-ac0a-120fea79548b

Feedback
We’ve implemented an easy way to report bugs and feedback inside the game. Just pressing F1 will bring up a feedback menu. Alongside your description, we’ll receive a screenshot and state of the game to try to reproduce the issue.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F11%2FBugs.png?alt=media&token=c9a262c4-a26d-4a5e-a00c-e53dbb727f00

Cross-platform tests
We received our Switch Dev kits last month and were able to play cross-platform! There are still many integrations, optimizations, and improved controller support to do. Still, it’s great that we develop for it early on!

If you want to read more about it, we made a post about it

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F11%2FSwitch.png?alt=media&token=d1781e8d-0bbe-4443-ae1a-624f3ac8d6c6

Load menu
We’ve always had a save system, but loading was a bit tricky and not 100% functional. We’ve now implemented a basic but proper menu and also integrated it with Steam for identifying users in multiplayer.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F11%2FLoad.gif?alt=media&token=19ae9ca0-f03c-4eb2-8d55-a1fdebd296d2

What’s next
This month we’ll split our time between coordination and development. 

Coordination

 We’ll be processing Kickstarter pledges and pre-order stores. We’re developing a simple tool to automate the process of assigning Discord roles and providing alpha backers with keys.
 Open up Discord channels for alphas.
 We’re working on an updated timeline that includes stretch-goals and assets from Kickstarter design tiers.
 We’re growing our team. It’s a gradual process as we want to have the right size to keep our current synergy.


Development
Our main priority this month is to deliver the updated alpha to backers and winners of contests, receive and categorize feedback and bugs.

We have a few things already going on, which we’re scheduled to finish this month:

 Sketch and try the dimensions of the updated map with new locations (Tundra and Turtle Islands).
 Seasons assets for The Land Between Two Rivers and Forest area.
 Work on the back story of the game, the Yakuans, and other roaming tribes.


We’ll also start working on the features defined in this month’s planning sessions.

Thank you once again for all your support!

Use the power of your social networks to spread the word of Pacha. When a milestone is reached a fire will light up 🔥. Rewards will unlock after a certain amount of fires are lit.

Before the Kickstarter campaign, the ways to light fires and unlock rewards are:

Follow us on Twitter
Follow us on Instagram
Join us on discord and participate in minigame


On the 23rd, we’ll reveal even more ways to light fires so you have more chances to earn rewards later on too.

You can check the status of the Challenge on our website and on Discord too!

Discord bot
One of the challenges that are unlocked today is a fresh-out-of-the-oven Discord bot. We wanted to give you a way to work towards a common goal in the Discord. Join us in our Clan’s virtual village to !plant, !water, !harvest, and !explore. The more we do, the more Contribution our Clan earns.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F10%2FDiscordVillage.png?alt=media

During and after the Kickstarter campaign, we’ll keep working on the bot adding more commands to grow our village. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/085126f7644637c184e05a8abc01f6557a1d7e96.png

We’ll be giving out alpha access to the top 2 Clan members that participate the most in February and in March! Details on Discord, join us & play!

Sneak peak
One of the traditions of this festival is telling the story of the Clan, how we got here, all we have achieved, and even a hint of the road that’s still to be walked. Maeri, one of the elders, will tell the story (somehow she managed to do a trailer so you can get a better picture). 

Here’s a sneak peak of what you’ll watch on the 23rd.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F10%2F0020_001_GIF_640.gif?alt=media
Oh no! Our world is changing! What are we to do now that the lands we used to roam are no longer the same? 

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F10%2F0280_001_GIF_640.gif?alt=media
The lights in the sky are our ancestor’s campfires and we can see them reflected on this rock at night. They must be trying to tell us something.

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F10%2F0310_002_GIF_640.gif?alt=media
This is an idea we’ve got from the start of the project and also something that has come up as a suggestion on Discord. The ability to customize your own pottery and tapestry! Want your face on the wall? How about your cat on that pot? 

https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F10%2FFollowButton.gif?alt=media

And with that we wrap up this edition! Thanks again for reading and for all your support. Help us reach more people, earn rewards, and get ready to celebrate the Kickstarter Festival on the 23rd!

notes.title: Devlog #8: 100% Whole Wheat
notes.content:
https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/12/1/devlog-8-food-is-everything/o_1eofb8m7e1dp6l5d1vj6pv56413.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/085126f7644637c184e05a8abc01f6557a1d7e96.png

Connect
We did our first livestream with Crytivo Connect showcasing the gameplay for the first time and explaining some of our core mechanics. Thanks everyone for joining and sharing your thoughts. If you haven’t watched it yet, it’s now on Youtube

[previewyoutube=5M-Lv4bmSDY;full][/previewyoutube]

Racing tournament
We felt we were missing some action, and we always wanted to include a sport or tournament inside the game to break the routine of planting and evolving. After some research we found that horse racing is one of the ancient sports and we immediately thought about how many rideable animals we have in Roots of Pacha.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/12/1/devlog-8-food-is-everything/o_1eobkg1k8ali1g7a17dqiae1eqg13.gif

We really had a lot of fun racing our animals. There’s still some work to do, and some of our ideas include giving stats to mounts, improving mounts with friendship and special items, choosing a team and becoming the star rider of a season.

Pacha Hearth
Pachans are very social and so they have a common building where they spend rainy days, gather for a warm meal and receive visitors. Vuak, the sha-man and spiritual leader of the clan, is the one in charge of welcoming people to this place. Here’s a preview of his room which is inside the building.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/12/1/devlog-8-food-is-everything/o_1eobkhe9dbe296b1m2g1t8e1qor8l.gif

Forest minimap
As we continue to develop the world of Roots of Pacha, we add minimap sections of it. This is how the forest minimap looks like.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/12/1/devlog-8-food-is-everything/o_1eobkie668it1p4m9pn1s1f12aa8v.gif

We’re also exploring if the minimap is something you already have, or if you have to complete it as you discover new areas.

Food producers and preservation
A few devlogs ago we talked about how important food preservation was in the stone age. The idea was not only to improve the shelf time of food but also its nutrition. 

For example, in the process of making bread, the natural yeast that is present in the grains not only make flour rise and produce a spongy bread, but they also make the nutrients of the grain available for the human body to absorb.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/12/1/devlog-8-food-is-everything/o_1eobkip51122u1ljo11v3lp1l4a9h.gif

At that point in time, most processes were manual and we felt it was a good idea to represent that in the game. This is the case of the Mortar and Pestle that’s used to grind grains into flours and also to mix, and whisk.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/12/1/devlog-8-food-is-everything/o_1eobkj6oc1hpk1r7e15a01q45a469m.gif

Once you’ve got flour, mix in a little bit of water and let the dough ferment for a few hours. The Fermenter is a processor in Roots of Pacha that lets the natural yeasts in grain, flours and fruits turn into other products.

As a side note, yes, we read your comments, and yes there will be booze making in Roots of Pacha. For better or for worse, alcohol is ingrained in human history.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/12/1/devlog-8-food-is-everything/o_1eobkjhp3ssn102v1efk1q7s1mbk9r.gif

Finally, after getting fermented dough, you shape it and throw it in the Oven to get that nice loaf.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/12/1/devlog-8-food-is-everything/o_1eobmqivn12e76jg12slsge1vk0u.gif

Another producer that we didn’t get a chance to show in the stream is the Solar Dryer. It’s made out of a couple of poles with nets in between that use the power of the sun to dry fruits and vegetables. The Solar Dryer accepts multiple items at once.

Taming minigame
https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/12/1/devlog-8-food-is-everything/o_1eobkkeppu03hagpscpnk1m7bb9.gif

After discovering the flute that lets you communicate with animals, you need to attune to them to increase friendship. Flute playing was too immediate and not very rewarding, so we are trying this minigame where friendship will increase depending on how you play the melody.

Fishing minigame
Fishing the shallow waters was a bit simple too, and we had a minigame we didn’t like where you had to hit keys in a certain order.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/12/1/devlog-8-food-is-everything/o_1eobkl2kasd21gkjd1d1pov1thcd7.gif

In the new one we developed this month, you have to remain calm and focus on one specific fish. Keep following it as it moves across the water nearby, but don’t do it too fast, the ripples will make it go away. Once you’re confident enough and you can see it, take a chance to fish it!.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/085126f7644637c184e05a8abc01f6557a1d7e96.png

That's it for this edition, thanks for reading. We hope to read your comments on Discord and see you next time!

notes.content:

Join us on 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/085126f7644637c184e05a8abc01f6557a1d7e96.png

Ohh look, that one’s special

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/11/2/devlog-7-ancestors/o_1em4fqi9kui45a510utrhc16ae13.gif

At first glance, all animals of a herd might look the same, but after closer inspection you’ll start to recognize different colors and patterns. Some special ones might appear on certain seasons or after an event happens.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/11/2/devlog-7-ancestors/o_1em4fr2b2qip26861an8culn1l.png

Develop a bond with the one you like the most and it might want to live with you and let you ride it.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/11/2/devlog-7-ancestors/o_1em4us98r1ksu9gp192k199q1qiu1o.gif

Cave paintings
Our ancestors used caves not only for shelter but to leave an impression of the way they lived, perhaps as a way to transcend, to communicate, or simply admiration for the surrounding nature.

The Clan uses cave walls too, to express their Ideas. As part of discovering the world, you’ll get to see their parietal art.

Riding

 https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/11/2/devlog-7-ancestors/o_1em4fvh211tm312r01o0llv1mc11q.png Nokk: What is this “riding” and animal?.
https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/11/2/devlog-7-ancestors/o_1em4g1b4b1h3tj1u80c1e7kain1v.png Okka: Make an animal like you, get on its back, and go places. 
https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/11/2/devlog-7-ancestors/o_1em4g1b4b1h3tj1u80c1e7kain1v.png Okka: Look, this is what I mean.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/11/2/devlog-7-ancestors/o_1em4g2jf1t9s1ndi3tk1ea1glv24.gif

 https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/11/2/devlog-7-ancestors/o_1em4fvh211tm312r01o0llv1mc11q.png Nokk: Ohhh, I see. That might work. 
https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/11/2/devlog-7-ancestors/o_1em4fvh211tm312r01o0llv1mc11q.png Nokk: Why is a heart floating around though?

Map
https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/11/2/devlog-7-ancestors/o_1em4g3deer17fmo1koevg311b729.gif
https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/11/2/devlog-7-ancestors/o_1em4g5718f941oa217s1ive1gu02e.png Grob: So you’re saying that the red thing on the wall is my house.
https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/11/2/devlog-7-ancestors/o_1em4g7os81im01fna7a24gv1nu52j.png Voda: Yes.
https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/11/2/devlog-7-ancestors/o_1em4g5718f941oa217s1ive1gu02e.png Grob: But I see my house. It’s right there.
https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/11/2/devlog-7-ancestors/o_1em4g7os81im01fna7a24gv1nu52j.png Voda: That’s right, but this is your house too. See, it’s to the left of the main fire.

[Grob tries to enter to painted house in the wall and bangs his head]

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/11/2/devlog-7-ancestors/o_1em4g5718f941oa217s1ive1gu02e.png Grob: I told you it wasn’t my house!
https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/11/2/devlog-7-ancestors/o_1em4g7os81im01fna7a24gv1nu52j.png Voda: ...

Eagle Eyes
Some Pachans actually do get the idea of a map. This is how it actually ends up looking after some research has been done.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/11/2/devlog-7-ancestors/o_1em4gcc4u1bn57ln17op1g3b1qjd2o.gif

- Never miss that Pachan you were looking for. Find hints for quests and important stuff they might have to tell you.
- Get an overview of your farm, or that new piece of land that you need to clear. Take a screenshot of your village and share it with your friends.
- See what’s being built and where.

2D is for Draw and Draw it again
If you’ve been following our feed you might have noticed a gradual change of style. As we play the game, we keep making changes to the style so that it can flow with the overall feeling. This month it was the time to refine the backgrounds. We felt it was a bit too cluttered and confusing and wanted to have more space in between things.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/11/2/devlog-7-ancestors/o_1em4ur0trpqj1boti5e4di1i4su.gif

Day of the Ancestors
Some say Halloween is a pagan festival. Well, we say it’s a pachan festival

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/11/2/devlog-7-ancestors/o_1em4gfek515ih5n913s81b02sel3b.gif

Even though there are no candies nor doors that can be knocked, Pachans remember their ancestors that day. 

It is a time to give thanks for the fall harvest (pumpkins, yay!), ask for the upcoming winter to be mild, and to be grateful to those that came before us and made possible that we’re here.

Fires & torches
We had a lot of different fires and wanted to change the style and behavior of them. Here’s a look of the central plaza at night, with a renewed central fire, new torches and lighting system.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/11/2/devlog-7-ancestors/o_1em4ggvfefju17qc1aus1olvois4t.gif

Would you like to dance with me?
Who doesn’t like gifts? Isn’t that the way we all develop friendships and eventually love? Don’t get us wrong, we love that mechanic, but we’re also exploring some other ways you might deepen your relationships with the Clan.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/11/2/devlog-7-ancestors/o_1em4ghu4ll5tqvh1hsvhgkl0m5n.gif

Now that we have the dance emote, we thought that dancing with other Pachans, when they feel like it, would be a good way to do it.

Crytivo Connect

November 13th we will be spreading the word of Pacha live on twitch.

We’ll be streaming Roots of Pacha, showcasing the gameplay for the first time ever! Join us to get to know us, watch us play, and for a surprise we’ve worked on this month. 

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/11/2/devlog-7-ancestors/o_1em4gjfp6jubalrlen1kvlu1b71.gif

Mark your calendars for Nov 13th and stay tuned for details on the time.

Will Pacha be able to make this our lucky day and impress you?

notes.title: Devlog #6: The Clan
notes.content:
Life at the Land Between Two Rivers
What did our ancestors do on an everyday basis? A lot of their time was probably spent gathering provisions in the warm seasons to be able to outlast the cold ones, making pottery and weaving baskets to hold their belongings, curing meats and fermenting grains. They also built basic structures and made the tools needed for survival. As social animals, they chatted, told stories, played music and danced.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1ejfkcsm6140o1vimef585sub3u.gif

In Roots of Pacha, each NPC excels at something, like Croll being the best at building. But all of them contribute to the everyday activities of the clan. You might find Gin, the Clan’s leader, training for a hunting expedition, or Jizu gathering plants in the forest for Ada, the healer, to use.

Lucky for you that’s what I like
Oh the things we cherish and the ones we hate. We improved the gift system so that NPCs will show a different portrait depending on what you give them. And because one man's trash is another man's treasure, you’ll have to discover what they like and what they don’t.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1ejdu8ri6lc2137n1lj8jfj1i7p18.gif

Buildings
Building takes time and sometimes a village. That’s why when the Clan decides to build something, the schedule of some NPCs change while in construction. How about some paint for that Sundial?

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1ejduangv19e05hm1ijb1e3k2mr1q.gif

Mini map
To make the world more immersive, we’re trying an approach where every quest, idea or cutscene is initiated by an NPC or by a location. Spreading out the events feels more realistic, but sometimes it’s too hard to find an NPC you’re looking for, or you just want to know where your friends are.

We’re developing a minimap per region with indications of the whereabouts of the Clan and key points of interest.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1eje11mnk16eqnbslbk10t51ulcu.png

Wondering how on earth could someone know the locations of everyone?. You’ll have to develop an idea with Voda, the tracker, to use the eagles' help.

Food preservation
Without proper refrigeration, the Clan needs ways to improve food nutrition and make preserves that can last longer. Some things need a few steps to be made but the ending result is always so satisfying and is a much valuable contribution to the Clan.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1ejdud89p17dc15qjahl10ii5tm24.png

Now, if we could only make some butter to go with it...

The power of fire
We’ve made improvements to the lights engine. Our goal is to add depth to some objects in the world. When you are walking through the forest, lights will illuminate the trees on top of you but not the bottom ones.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1ejduer3j18b5177l182312n01i1k29.gif

In the darkness of the night and the deepness of the caves, you need to carry a torch to see further around you. 

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1ejduik685cv92n1d8j1rbebpu73.gif

New plants
It all starts and ends with plants, right? If you’re in our Discord, you may have noticed our fascination for the natural world (if you’re not, join us).

We’ve changed the look of the plants when they’re in the wild, they’re usually smaller and not very nutritious. As you plant them and keep growing them, they’ll evolve into their improved versions with larger roots, fruits and seeds, brighter colors and nice scents (we’re working on how to propagate smell through the speakers, so far nothing).

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1ejdujh51h4un4g14832dnoa78.png

We also thought plants looked a bit too far apart, and now they have a better sense of depth. 

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1ejdul3vf1ej616411e2d8rk1s5a7d.gif

Baaaaaa
So we have a mountain, and what animal likes mountains? Yep, goats. We researched the oldest domesticated goats and one of them is the Ibex. Without further ado:

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1ejdup1db1meqsg31r46oiq10ucbb.gif

Under the water
As we develop more locations, we’re adding fishing spots. Some of the new fish you’ll encounter at different times of days and throughout the seasons:

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1ejdusrvf1f621h7r39ammigqc3.png

In-game emotes
All that hard work is fine, but we needed a way to celebrate your first successful harvest with your friends.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1ejdurqug4shv2a1tk57ke1274bl.gif

Dance is so ingrained in human history, it even appears in cave art. It’s used to perform ritual and religious ceremonies, as a way to connect with each other socially, and to entertain. Dance is important in Roots of Pacha too, and might even help you strengthen friendship with the Clan.

SFX
As we polish the world, we continue to add more sound effects. Have you ever heard an Ostrich?
Ostrich - SFX

Discord
We’ve added more emojis with NPCs expressions, an animated gif icon and a couple of new channels where we revere mother nature and prehistoric science.

Join us!
https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/9/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-5/o_1eh2dh9negb3usc1nt13751qo5u.png

notes.title: Devlog #5: Depths of Pacha
notes.content:
https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/9/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-5/o_1eh079kuh1hirtc22ad1ol3e1c58.png

Caves

Pacha, our mother earth, can be felt in every part of the world. She has blessed us with cracks in the mountains, entrances to deep caves that get us closer to her. Mysteries, older than our Clan’s oldest ancestor, await in their depths. 


https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/9/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-5/o_1egueaala191n2mdjsr157s10m53c.jpg

This past month we worked on the first cave that you’ll have access to. Caves are places where you can obtain resources, but also where you’ll connect with Pacha, and discover more about the spiritual world.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/9/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-5/o_1egue95c51g89191mhuaj5reaku.gif

The wise Owl, a son of Pacha, welcomes you upon entering. Its powers feel strong here, almost as if we could use them too. 

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/9/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-5/o_1egvugrbrrcrmct11al1pon14sju.gif

If you are brave enough, you’ll venture deeper. What are those strange artifacts? It looks like they have a purpose, a way to arrange them maybe...

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/9/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-5/o_1egueittmsrqqqknp61ruffaf46.png

Inside the cave, you’ll reach special rooms. They’re filled with resources buried long ago when the earth formed, or with stories from other humans that explored the caves before you.

Tools
https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/9/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-5/o_1eguek8qg1g2k152e1of81r57jhv54.gif
Once again, it will be up to you to discover the tools you want to use. Once discovered, you’ll gather the materials and develop more ideas on how to use them.

These are some of the resources you’ll need to upgrade the tools.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/9/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-5/o_1egvuk4rk1a94ljdsg8q3f120v3g.gif

We wanted to talk about one of the starting tools, the handaxe. You might have seen it in some of our previous posts or tweets.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/9/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-5/o_1eguelagtm9en161sps18cg2835e.gif

It appears to be just a rock, but it’s not any rock. It has years of perfecting the art of chipping flakes to make it a pointed tool, without breaking it in the process. The other end should be blunt and relatively thick so we can hold it firmly. 

Although it’s not very strong, it lets you do a wide variety of tasks. From breaking small twigs and preparing soil, to fishing in shallow waters and extracting materials from soft ores.

Decorate!
https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/9/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-5/o_1eh0anjjg1gjc1d39e40oeg1bn9u.gif
Once you get your home, it’s time to make  it yours! How about a stone table here, with a rug underneath?. You can even get some help from your friends!

Be yourself
Living in the stone age doesn’t mean you need to be all ragged and dirty (unless that’s what you like). Customize your character by choosing a preferred body type, skin tone, eye color, hair color and style, clothes and shoes.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/9/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-5/o_1egufdadeers14au1073b914epeb.gif

This month we’ve added some new clothes and colors, and will continue to do so. We also plan to add accessories!

Library
There’s nothing in the Clan more precious than knowledge. It’s what drives the Clan forward by discovering and inventing stuff. 

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/9/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-5/o_1egufdpfi162a125b1t301icc1ah1el.png

One of the buildings you can build is the library. This is where Garrek spends most of his time. He’s always talking about weird things, like why things fall to the floor instead of going up. He also likes mixing materials and experimenting with ropes and rocks. 

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/9/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-5/o_1eh580och18s81qhl1i4cf9j14epu.png

By bringing Garrek things that you collect in the wild, new plants and their produce, and anything else that exists in the world, the Clan’s knowledge will increase. In the library, you can display any items you want and preserve them in amber stone for posterity.

Sundial
Another building we developed this month is the sundial. It might seem a bit advanced for the time, but in some way or another, using the sun’s shadows was probably one of the first ways we had to track time.

https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/9/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-5/o_1eguf0u651ucd1ir41jntlop1hf0b0.gif

Also, did you know the thing that the thing that projects the shadow is called the “gnomon.”  That alone made it a must have in Roots of Pacha.

When you build it, time in the world will be more accurate so you don’t miss that NPC you were hoping to give a flower to.

Drop
https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/9/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-5/o_1eguf18o71sfo17m91ntmqdc473b5.gif
A way to share resources, or just to clear your bag after collecting sooo many rocks. Drop it to the floor, so someone else can pick it up. If you leave it overnight, wild animals take them away so make sure to collect anything you need.

Discord Emojis!
This has been something we’ve wanted to do for a while.
